8. Complete the required **System Fields** and **Uploaded File Columns** in the table.
   1. Click **+ Add Field** to add additional fields to the table.
   2. Only one row is required; however, completing more will help increase the chances of a [high](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**[Match Rate](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**.
9. Select **Create**.

Your Matched audience will immediately begin processing. You can monitor its current status by following the steps outlined in Review a Matched audience.

## Create a Matched audience (Healthcare)

Healthcare advertisers can create the following types of Matched audiences:

- NPI-based (HCP, Nurse)
- Non-NPI based (Nurse)
- Patient (*beta*)
- Generic

Follow these steps to access the **+ Create Audience** workflow for all types:

1. Open the Audiences app.
2. Select **Matched Audience**.
3. Click **+ Create New**. This will open the **Create Matched Audience** pop-up window.

### NPI-based (HCP, Nurse) (Healthcare)

> **HCP or Nurse Matched audience pricing notice:** When you create a Matched audience from NPI IDs, we’ll prompt you to select a Data Partner. We directly ingest NPI numbers from these leading industry sources, which power our identity graph with over 80% coverage of the HCP universe and result in maximum unique campaign reach. There is a cost associated with targeting these segments, which varies by data provider and can be reviewed once the audience is fully generated and features a **Ready** status.

Follow these steps to create a new NPI-based (HCP, Nurse) Matched audience for Healthcare campaigns:

1. Enter a name for the audience.
2. Choose **HCP** or **Nurse** from the **Select Type** menu.
3. Select the **Data Partner** of your choice.
4. Add an XLSX or CSV file containing the list of NPIs.
   1. Download the **Sample File** to ensure your file is formatted correctly.
   2. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to upload it, click **Upload File** and select it.
   3. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to drag and drop it, select the desired file and drag it into any area of the dashed rectangle.
   4. If the desired file is stored in an external account such as Google Drive or Dropbox, select the corresponding company’s icon.
      1. A pop-up window will open and prompt you to log in, accept any applicable privacy settings, and select the desired file from the online drive.
5. Open the **Select Matching Criteria** menu and select the system field(s) contained in your file that will be used for audience matching.
6. Complete the required **System Fields** and **Uploaded File Columns** in the table.
   1. Click **+ Add Field** to add additional fields to the table.
   2. Only one row is required; however, completing more will help increase the chances of a [high](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**[Match Rate](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**.
7. Select **Create**.

Your Matched audience will immediately begin processing. You can monitor its current status by following the steps outlined in Review a Matched audience.

### Non-NPI based (Nurse) (Healthcare)

Follow these steps to create a new Non-NPI based (Nurse) Matched audience for Healthcare campaigns:

1. Enter a name for the audience.
2. Choose **Non-NPI Nurse** from the **Select Type** menu.
3. Data360 is selected by default to enable audience matching for the Non-NPI Nurse audience.
4. Add an XLSX or CSV file containing the list of NPIs.
   1. Download the **Sample File** to ensure your file is formatted correctly.
   2. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to upload it, click **Upload File** and select it.
   3. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to drag and drop it, select the desired file and drag it into any area of the dashed rectangle.
   4. If the desired file is stored in an external account such as Google Drive or Dropbox, select the corresponding company’s icon.
      1. A pop-up window will open and prompt you to log in, accept any applicable privacy settings, and select the desired file from the online drive.
5. Open the **Select Matching Criteria** menu and select the system field(s) contained in your file that will be used for audience matching.
6. Complete the required **System Fields** and **Uploaded File Columns** in the table.
   1. Click **+ Add Field** to add additional fields to the table.
   2. Only one row is required; however, completing more will help increase the chances of a [high](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**[Match Rate](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**.
7. Select **Create**.

Your Matched audience will immediately begin processing. You can monitor its current status by following the steps outlined in Review a Matched audience.

### Patient (Healthcare)

> **Beta notice:** Access to Patient Matched audiences is currently limited to users participating in a closed, invitation-only beta testing program. General availability for this feature is coming soon.

Follow these steps to upload a file that contains patient details for audience matching:

1. Enter a name for the audience.
2. Choose **Patient** from the **Select Type** menu.
3. Add an XLSX or CSV file containing the patient list.
   1. Download the **Sample File** to ensure your file is formatted correctly.
   2. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to upload it, click **Upload File** and select it.
   3. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to drag and drop it, select the desired file and drag it into any area of the dashed rectangle.
   4. If the desired file is stored in an external account such as Google Drive or Dropbox, select the corresponding company’s icon.
      1. A pop-up window will open and prompt you to log in, accept any applicable privacy settings, and select the desired file from the online drive.
4. Review the consent disclaimer, and select the checkbox to confirm that you understand and agree to the listed terms.
5. Open the **Select Matching Criteria** menu and select the system field(s) contained in your file that will be used for audience matching.
6. Complete the required **System Fields** and **Uploaded File Columns** in the table.
   1. Click **+ Add Field** to add additional fields to the table.
   2. Only one row is required; however, completing more will help increase the chances of a [high](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**[Match Rate](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4230c7d4ca)**.
7. Select **Create**.

Your Matched audience will immediately begin processing. You can monitor its current status by following the steps outlined in Review a Matched audience.

### Generic (Healthcare)

Follow these steps to create a Generic Matched audience for healthcare campaigns:

1. Enter a name for the audience.
2. Choose **Generic** from the **Select Type** menu.
3. Follow steps 4 through 7 of the NPI-based (HCP, Nurse) (Healthcare) workflow.

Your Matched audience will immediately begin processing. You can monitor its current status by following the steps outlined in Review a Matched audience.

## Manage a Matched audience

Use the **Matched Audience** page of the Audiences app to review, search, sort, or filter your existing Matched audiences. You can also use this page to change their name or delete them; generate their audience insights; and assign them to campaigns.

### Review a Matched audience

Follow these steps to review an existing Matched audience:

1. Locate the audience you’d like to review.
   1. Search by **ID** or **Audience Name**.
   2. Filter by **Status** for all audiences and by **Type** for Healthcare audiences.
   3. Open the column selector to add or remove a table column.
2. Select the desired audience’s ID in the **ID** column. This will open the audience in a pop-up window, where you can review its details.
3. Once the audience features a **Ready** status, you can also review additional data and insights.
   1. Review the audience’s **Reach**, **Records**, **Match Rate**, **Cost (CPM)**, and **Status** in the summary panel.
   2. If you created a Healthcare audience, review the **Type** and **Data Partner** in the summary panel.
   3. Review and/or download the file you uploaded when you created the audience.
4. Select **Done** to close the pop-up window and return to the **Matched Audience** page

### Re-Match a Matched audience

> **Re-Match notice:** After a Re-Match is complete, the Matched audience’s Reach may increase, decrease, or remain the same. Note that–if the Re-Matched audience is the only mapped audience and its Reach is lower than the original Matched audience’s reach–the campaign may stop delivering. No campaign disruption will occur during Re-Match processing; any associated campaigns will continue to target the existing Matched audience until the process is complete. Refer to [Matched audience overview - Re-Match](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_0cc9c103cf) for more details on audience Re-Matching and eligibility criteria.

Follow these steps to retrigger the audience-matching process, which fetches the most recent and relevant match data and updates the audience’s Reach and Match Rate details:

1. Select the refresh icon next to an eligible audience. This will open the **Confirm Audience Re-Match** pop-up window.
2. Review the disclaimer and select **Re-Match** to confirm your selection.

### Retry a failed Matched audience

Follow these steps to attempt to Re-Match a Matched audience featuring a **Failed** status:

1. Select the refresh icon next to an eligible **Failed** audience. This will open the **Confirm Audience Retry** pop-up window.
2. Review the disclaimer and select **Retry** to confirm your selection.

### Edit a Matched audience

> **More on editing Matched audiences:** Only an existing Matched audience’s name can be edited. If you’d like to apply changes to the audience’s other settings—such as its source file or type—creating a new one instead.

Follow these steps to edit an existing Matched audience’s name:

1. Select the existing name from the table’s **Audience Name** column, and type the new audience name directly in the cell.
2. Click the checkmark icon to confirm your selection.

### Duplicate a Matched audience

Duplication isn't supported for Matched audiences.

Follow the steps outlined in Create a Matched audience (Specialty, Political) or Create a Matched Audience (Healthcare) to create a new audience instead.

### Delete a Matched audience

> **Audience deletion notice:** Note that deleted audiences are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent.

You can delete Matched audiences individually or in bulk. They must feature a **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** status; and their **Allowlist/Blocklist** count must be **0**.

Follow these steps to delete a Matched audience.

1. Select the checkboxes next to the desired audience(s).
2. Click **Delete**.

The deleted audience(s) will no longer appear in the Audiences app.

### Generate Audience Insights

> **Matched audience eligibility notice:** Audience Insights reports are available for eligible standard Matched audiences, Voter ID Matched audiences, HCP or Nurse Matched audiences, and Non-NPI Nurse Matched audiences. Patient Matched audiences are not supported.

You can generate, download, and send insights for each of your Matched audiences at no additional cost. These insights provide a holistic and in-depth view of user attributes to help you craft highly targeted and personalized campaigns.

Refer to these dedicated resources to learn more about generating Audience Insights for your Matched audiences:

- [Audience Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8337863-audience-insights-report-overview#h_cba54235f2)
- [Audience Insights report metrics](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8337863-audience-insights-report-overview#h_cba54235f2)
- [Generate or manage an Audience Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8337876-generate-or-manage-an-audience-insights-report)
- [Troubleshoot an Audience Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8337876-generate-or-manage-an-audience-insights-report)

## Assign a Matched audience to a campaign

A single campaign can target up to 20 audiences. You can assign Matched audiences to new and existing campaigns, and from the Audiences and Campaigns apps. Refer to [Assign an audience to a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497815-assign-an-audience-to-a-campaign) for step-by-step instructions.

## Review data costs

The **Data Cost** metric represents a campaign’s total spend on targeting and/or blocking data segments. This includes the total amount spent on audience targeting.

You can review a campaign’s data costs in the following ways:

- From the Dashboard app
- From the Campaigns app
- From the Reports app

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Dashboard app

Follow the steps outlined in [Customize a dashboard table - Add or remove a column](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10471726-create-or-manage-a-dashboard#h_35346e0a69) to choose which metrics are displayed on your dashboard. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it.

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Campaigns app

In the Campaigns app, open the column selector to choose which metrics are displayed in the table. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it.

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Reports app

Follow the steps outlined in [Generate a report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343879-generate-manage-or-send-a-report#h_6d07656e4b) to create a custom report. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it to the report.

## Locate additional Matched audience resources

- [Matched audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview)
- [Troubleshoot a Matched audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748458-troubleshoot-a-matched-audience)

# Troubleshoot a Matched audience

## Matched audience troubleshooting overview

All advertisers can create and target Matched audiences if their account and campaign meet certain eligibility criteria. Advertisers belonging to certain verticals, such as Healthcare and Political, may also be eligible to use NPI data or Voter data to generate audience segments that are specific to those verticals.

If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating, managing, or targeting a Matched audience, refer to these resources first:

- [Matched audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage a Matched audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience)

Return to this article to address and resolve other issues that you may encounter related to Matched audiences.

## Troubleshoot Matched audience creation or management issues

### Unable to duplicate an audience

Duplication isn't supported for Matched audiences.

Follow the steps outlined in [Create a Matched audience (Specialty, Political)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience#h_a50f1a4473) or [Create a Matched Audience (Healthcare)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience#h_9c96dd379b) to create a new audience instead.

### Unable to edit an audience

Only an existing Matched audience’s name can be edited. You can rename an audience directly from the **Matched Audience** table by selecting the cell containing the existing name.

### Unable to change an audience’s name

You can change an existing audience’s name by selecting it in the table’s **Audience Name** column.

Type the new audience name directly in the cell, and confirm your selection by clicking the checkmark icon.

### Unable to delete an audience

You can delete audiences individually or in bulk. Every selected audience must be unassigned from all campaigns before you can delete them.

You can easily reference whether an audience is assigned to any campaigns in the **Allowlist/Blocklist** column. Audiences with an **Allowlist/Blocklist** value of **0** can be deleted.

### Unable to locate a deleted audience

Deleted audiences are automatically removed from the Audiences app as soon as you complete this action. For this reason, none of the Matched audiences listed in the Audiences app will feature a **Deleted** status.

### Unable to review audience reach

Audience reach details generate automatically once the audience progresses from a **Processing** status to a **Ready** status. Refer to [Matched audience statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_7fca54b9c5) and [Key terms and concepts - Records, Match Rate, and Reach](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_d4f8225cc8) for more information.

### Audience is in Processing status

Depending on the size of the Matched audience, it may take 24 to 48 hours for us to complete the audience-matching process. Once completed, the audience’s status will change from **Processing** to **Ready**. If something goes wrong during audience creation, then it’ll feature a **Failed** status instead.

### Unable to locate HCP, Nurse, Non-NPI Nurse, or Patient ( beta ) Matched audience options

> Access to Patient Matched audiences is currently limited to users participating in a closed, invitation-only beta testing program. General availability for this feature is coming soon.

You’ll have the option to select an audience **Type** when you add your audience’s settings. Refer to [Create a Matched audience (Healthcare)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience#h_9c96dd379b) for step-by-step instructions.

Note that only Healthcare advertisers are eligible to create HCP, Nurse, Non-NPI Nurse, or Patient Matched audiences. Contact your account admin if you believe you should have access to these audience-creation options but are unable to locate them in the Audiences app.

### Unable to locate Voter Matched audience options

Note that only Political advertisers are eligible to create Matched audiences from voter data. However, Political advertisers can complete this step by creating a standard Matched audience and uploading a file that contains voter details. Refer to [Create a Matched audience (Specialty, Political)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience#h_a50f1a4473) for step-by-step instructions.

### Unable to generate audience insights

You can generate audience insights for Matched audiences that feature a **Ready** status and include at least 10K **Records**. Note that Audience Insights reporting doesn’t currently support Patient Matched audiences; however, all other Matched audience types are supported when they meet the other [eligibility criteria](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8337863-audience-insights-report-overview).

Refer to [Audience Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8337863-audience-insights-report-overview) and [Generate or manage an Audience Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8337876-generate-or-manage-an-audience-insights-report) for additional support.

### Unable to further segment an audience

Each file you upload to a Matched audience creates a single target audience. This audience can’t be further segmented.

If you’d like to segment your NPI list, Voter list, or other first-party data into multiple audiences, you’ll need to create one file for each audience you wish to target. Refer to [Create or manage a Matched audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience) for step-by-step instructions.

### Unable to upload additional source files

Each Matched audience can include one source file containing your NPI list, Voter list, or other first-party data. In other words, the ratio of source file to Matched audience is 1:1. Repeat the processes outlined in [Create or manage a Matched audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience) for each audience.

### Unable to Re-Match an audience

An audience’s Re-Match eligibility is determined by the audience sub-type and the number of days that have passed since the audience was last created or Re-Matched.

Refer to [Matched audience overview - Re-Match](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_0cc9c103cf) for more details.

### Audience Re-Match failed

An audience undergoing the Re-Match process may fail for any of the following reasons:

- A system error or technical error occurred during processing.
- The newly Re-Matched audience’s Reach would have equaled less than 10 users.

Follow the steps outlined in [Retry a failed Matched audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience#h_a2f9791667) to try again.

## Troubleshoot Matched audience targeting issues

### New campaign - Unable to select a PG campaign type

PG campaigns aren’t eligible for Matched audience targeting. When you create a new campaign that will target the Matched audience, the **Advanced** option is selected by default, and the **PG** option is disabled.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to a PG campaign

Only **Advanced** campaigns are eligible for targeting Matched audiences. For this reason, the **Audiences** section is intentionally excluded from **PG** campaigns.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to an Advanced campaign

Campaigns typically support targeting multiple audience types. A campaign targeting an ABM audience, however, must only include one or more ABM audiences. For example, a campaign can’t target a Matched audience if it’s already targeting an ABM audience. Refer to [ABM audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10560051-account-based-marketing-abm-audience-overview) for more information, and confirm that the audience is targeting only non-ABM audiences and segments.

If the campaign isn’t targeting an ABM audience, confirm how many audiences it’s targeting instead. One campaign can target up to 20 audiences.

### Existing campaign - Campaign is missing from list

If you’re attempting to add the Matched audience to an existing campaign, and that campaign isn’t available in the **Campaigns** list, the campaign isn’t eligible for Matched audience targeting. Refer to [Matched audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_6cd565b71b) for more details.

### Add To Campaign button is disabled

The **Add To Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting and/or none of your campaigns are currently eligible.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Matched audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_6cd565b71b) for more details.

### Create Campaign button is disabled

The **Create Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Matched audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_6cd565b71b) for more details.

## Locate additional Matched audience resources

- [Create or manage a Matched audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience)

# Create or manage a Segmented audience

## Segmented audience overview

> **Partner with Vera:** Vera serves as a versatile partner that simplifies and streamlines complex operations across the campaign lifecycle. This includes creating and managing Matched audiences in the Vera app. Refer to ["Vera - IQM's artificial intelligence (AI) agent" collection overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15493648-vera-iqm-s-artificial-intelligence-ai-agent-collection-overview) to get started.

Segmented audiences include groups of users who share common characteristics. You’ll add segments or groups of segments to the audience to reach that unique group of users. These audiences can be highly specific or more broad, depending on your campaign’s goals and your scale considerations.

Refer to [Segmented audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview) for more information and eligibility requirements, or continue reading to create and manage a Segmented audience in the IQM platform.

## Create a Segmented audience

You can create one Segmented audience at a time in the Audiences app. Follow these steps to create a new Segmented audience:

1. Open the Audiences app.
2. Select **Segmented Audience**.
3. Click **+ Create New**. This will open the **Create Segmented Audience** pop-up window.
4. Enter a name for the audience.
5. Select the search bar to browse and select audience segments from the data provider of your choice.
   1. Enter search terms, separated by commas, to search for specific audience characteristics.
   2. Download your search results if you’d like to review them in a file.
   3. Sort the segments **By Reach** or **By Price**.
   4. Filter by **Vertical** or **Source** to refine your search results.
   5. Select one or more audience segments to add them to the audience, and note that all segments added to this [Segment Group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_31da47f45c) are assigned an [“OR” relationship](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_31da47f45c).
6. If desired, select **+ Add Segment Group** to a new group.
   1. Choose whether the segments in the new [Segment Group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_31da47f45c) are assigned an [“OR” or “AND” relationship](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_31da47f45c).
   2. Follow step 5 to select the segments you’d like to add to the second Segment Group.
   3. Repeat step 6, if desired, to add more Segment Groups.
7. Review estimated **Reach** and **Cost** details for the audience.
8. Select **Create** to create the Segmented audience.

Your Segmented audience will immediately begin processing. You can monitor its current status by following the steps outlined in Review a Segmented audience.

## Manage a Segmented audience

Use the **Segmented Audience** page of the Audiences app to review, search, sort, or filter your existing Segmented audiences. You can also use this page to edit, duplicate, or delete them; and to assign them to campaigns.

### Review a Segmented audience

Follow these steps to locate and review an existing Segmented audience:

1. Locate the audience you’d like to review.
   1. Search by **ID** or **Audience Name**.
   2. Filter by **Status**.
   3. Open the column selector to add or remove a table column.
2. Select the desired audience ID in the **ID** column. This will open the audience in a pop-up window, where you can review its details.
3. Once the Segmented audience features a **Ready** status, you can review additional details.
   1. Review the audience’s **Reach**, **Cost (CPM)**, and **Status** in the summary panel.
   2. Review each audience segment and its details, including which belong to each Segment Group, in the table.
   3. Review available insights related to genders, age groups, devices, and/or geographies in the **Audience Breakdown** panel.
4. Select **Done** to close the pop-up window and return to the **Segmented Audience** page.

### Edit a Segmented audience

> **Audience-edit notice:** The edits you apply to an existing audience will automatically be reflected in the campaigns you’ve assigned it to. These changes may affect the performance of those campaigns.

Follow these steps to edit an existing Segmented audience:

1. Select the pencil icon from the desired audience’s **Actions** column. This will open the **Edit Segmented Audience** pop-up window.
2. Follow the steps outlined in Create a Segmented audience to apply your desired changes to the audience’s name, Segment Groups, and/or Segment Group relationships.
3. Select **Save** to apply your changes to the existing audience.

### Duplicate a Segmented audience

You can duplicate one **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** Segmented audience at a time.

Follow these steps to duplicate an existing Segmented audience:

1. In the **Actions** column, select the page icon next to the audience that you’d like to duplicate. This will open the **Duplicate Segmented Audience** pop-up window.
2. Follow steps 4 through 7 of the Create a Segmented audience workflow to name the audience and choose which segments and Segment Groups it should include.
   1. If no changes are applied, the duplicated audience will include the same segments as the existing audience, and its **Audience Name** will show “Copy of” followed by the existing audience’s name.
3. Select **Duplicate** to create the duplicated audience.

The duplicated audience will appear in the **Segmented Audience** table of the Audiences app and feature a **Processing** status. The original audience will remain unchanged.

### Delete a Segmented audience

> **Audience deletion notice:** Note that deleted audiences are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent. As a safeguard, consider duplicating and updating the existing audience to reflect any desired changes.

You can delete Segmented audiences individually or in bulk. They must feature a **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** status; and their **Allowlist/Blocklist** count must be **0**.

Follow these steps to delete a Segmented audience.

1. To delete audiences individually, use the **Actions** column to select the trash can icon next to the individual audience that you’d like to delete.
2. To delete audiences in bulk:
   1. Select the checkboxes next to the desired audiences.
   2. Click **Delete**.

The deleted audience(s) will no longer appear in the Audiences app.

## Assign a Segmented audience to a campaign

Segmented audiences can be assigned to new and existing campaigns, and from the Audiences and Campaigns apps. Refer to [Assign an audience to a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497815-assign-an-audience-to-a-campaign) for step-by-step instructions.

## Review data costs

The **Data Cost** metric represents a campaign’s total spend or targeting and/or blocking data segments. This includes the total amount spent on audience targeting.

You can review a campaign’s data costs in the following ways:

- From the Dashboard app
- From the Campaigns app
- From the Reports app

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Dashboard app

Follow the steps outlined in [Customize a dashboard table - Add or remove a column](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10471726-create-or-manage-a-dashboard#h_35346e0a69) to choose which metrics are displayed on your dashboard. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it.

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Campaigns app

In the Campaigns app, open the column selector to choose which metrics are displayed in the table. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it.

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Reports app

Follow the steps outlined in [Generate a report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343879-generate-manage-or-send-a-report#h_6d07656e4b) to create a custom report. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it to the report.

## Troubleshoot Segmented audience creation or management issues

### Unable to duplicate an audience

You can duplicate **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** Segmented audiences; however, bulk duplication isn’t currently supported. Ensure that you select only one Segmented audience at a time before attempting to duplicate those audiences.

### Unable to edit an audience

You can edit one **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** Segmented audience at a time.

Follow the steps outlined in [Edit a Segmented audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11749120-create-or-manage-a-segmented-audience#h_785db42aae) to apply and save any changes such as name edits, adding or removing audience segments, and managing Segment Groups and relationships.

### Unable to change an audience’s name

You can change an existing audience’s name directly from the table by selecting it in the **Audience Name** column. Type the new audience name in the cell, and click the checkmark icon to confirm your selection.

Follow the steps outlined in [Edit a Segmented audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11749120-create-or-manage-a-segmented-audience#h_785db42aae) to apply and save any changes such as name edits, adding or removing audience segments, and managing Segment Groups and relationships.

### Unable to delete an audience

You can delete audiences individually or in bulk. Every selected audience must be unassigned from all campaigns before you can delete them.

You can easily reference whether an audience is assigned to any campaigns in the **Allowlist/Blocklist** column. Audiences with an **Allowlist/Blocklist** value of **0** can be deleted.

### Unable to locate a deleted audience

Deleted audiences are automatically removed from the Audiences app as soon as you complete this action. For this reason, none of the Segmented audiences listed in the Audiences app will feature a **Deleted** status.

### Unable to review audience reach

Audience reach details generate automatically once the audience progresses from a **Processing** status to a **Ready** status. This is also when key audience insights become available in the [Audience Breakdown](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_dca855b05b) panel.

Refer to [Segmented audience statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_2182acc925) for more information.

### Unable to review Audience Breakdown details

**Audience Breakdown** insights automatically generate once the audience progresses from a **Processing** status to a **Ready** status.

Refer to [Segmented audience statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_2182acc925) for more information.

### Audience is in Processing status

Depending on the size of the Segmented audience, it may take 24 to 48 hours for its status to change from **Processing** to **Ready**. If something goes wrong during audience creation, then it’ll feature a **Failed** status instead.

### Unable to locate Healthcare audience segments

All Healthcare audience segments are included in the **IQM Healthcare** data segment category. Segments from individual data providers are included in this category.

Note that only Healthcare advertisers are eligible to browse and add Healthcare segments to Segmented audiences. Contact your account admin if you believe you should have access to these segments but are unable to locate them in the Audiences app.

### Unable to locate Political audience segments

All Political audience segments are included in the **IQM Political** data segment category. Segments from individual data providers are included in this category.

Note that only Political advertisers are eligible to browse and add Political segments to Segmented audiences. Contact your account admin if you believe you should have access to these segments but are unable to locate them in the Audiences app.

### Unable to apply an “AND” relationship to a Segment Group

A single Segment Group always applies an “OR” relationship to each audience segment within it. This means that your campaign will target a user if they’re included in any of the Segmented audience segments that you added to the group, as long as all other campaign targeting criteria are met.

You can, however, choose an “AND” or an “OR” relationship between each Segment Group. Refer to [Segment Groups and relationships](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_04c5d75525) for more information.

## Troubleshoot Segmented audience targeting issues

### New campaign - Unable to select a PG campaign type

PG campaigns aren’t eligible for Segmented audience targeting. When you create a new campaign that will target the Segmented audience, the **Advanced** option is selected by default, and the **PG** option is disabled.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to a PG campaign

Only **Advanced** campaigns are eligible for targeting Segmented audiences. For this reason, the **Audiences** section is intentionally excluded from **PG** campaigns.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to an Advanced campaign

Campaigns typically support targeting multiple audience types. A campaign targeting an NPI-based audience, however, must only include one or more NPI-based audiences. For example, a campaign can’t target [IQM Healthcare audience segments](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_cde05c8585) if it’s already targeting a Retargeted audience consisting of your website's past visitors.

If the campaign isn’t targeting an NPI-based audience, confirm how many audiences it’s targeting instead. One campaign can target up to 20 audiences.

### Existing campaign - Campaign is missing from list

If you’re attempting to add the Segmented audience to an existing campaign, and that campaign isn’t available in the **Campaigns** list, the campaign isn’t eligible for Segmented audience targeting. Refer to [Segmented audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_8903263db7) for more details.

### Add To Campaign button is disabled

The **Add To Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting and/or none of your campaigns are currently eligible.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Segmented audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_8903263db7) for more details.

### Create Campaign button is disabled

The **Create Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Segmented audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_8903263db7) for more details.

## Locate additional Segmented audience resources

- [Segmented audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage a Segmented audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11749120-create-or-manage-a-segmented-audience)

# Troubleshoot a Lookalike audience

## Lookalike audience troubleshooting overview

All advertisers can create and target Lookalike audiences from their eligible Matched audiences if their account and campaigns meet certain requirements. If you encounter or are blocked from creating, managing, or targeting a Lookalike audience, refer to these resources first:

- [Lookalike audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage a Lookalike audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7019248-create-or-manage-a-lookalike-audience)

Return to this article to address and resolve other issues that you may encounter related to Lookalike audiences.

## Troubleshoot Lookalike audience creation or management issues

### Unable to duplicate an audience

You can duplicate **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** Lookalike audiences; however, bulk duplication isn’t currently supported. Ensure that you select only one Lookalike audience at a time before attempting to duplicate those audiences.

### Unable to edit an audience

Editing isn’t currently supported for Lookalike audiences. Consider duplicating the audience instead to create a new audience based on an existing one.

### Unable to change an audience’s name

You can change an existing audience’s name by selecting it in the table’s **Audience Name** column.

Type the new audience name directly in the cell, and confirm your selection by clicking the checkmark icon.

### Unable to delete an audience

You can delete audiences individually or in bulk. Every selected audience must be unassigned from all campaigns before you can delete them.

You can easily reference whether an audience is assigned to any campaigns in the **Allowlist/Blocklist** column. Audiences with an **Allowlist/Blocklist** value of **0** can be deleted.

### Unable to locate a deleted audience

Deleted audiences are automatically removed from the Audiences app as soon as you complete this action. For this reason, none of the Lookalike audiences listed in the Audiences app will feature a **Deleted** status.

### Unable to review audience reach

Audience reach details generate automatically once the audience progresses from a **Processing** status to a **Ready** status.

Refer to [Lookalike audience statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview#h_d856cc9a62) for more information.

### Source audience is missing from list

Only eligible Matched audiences will appear in the campaign selection field as you build your new Lookalike audience. Refer to [Lookalike audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview#h_2a84cf69b8) for additional support.

### Unsure of Audience Size and Similarity settings

Your Lookalike audience’s **Audience Size and Similarity** settings are intended to help you strike the balance between scale and value. Keep in mind that the relationship between the audience’s size and similarity is inversely proportional. This means that a highly similar audience will be smaller in size, and a less similar audience will be larger in size.

Refer to [Lookalike audience key terms and concepts - Audience Size and Similarity](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview#h_713ea3f391) for additional support.

### Audience reach is too small

The more narrow your audience settings, the fewer users will be added to that audience. We recommend loosening the audience’s **Size and Similarity** settings and/or adding additional locations to its **Geo Expansion** settings to allow for greater reach.

Consider also using forecasting and reporting tools to determine your campaigns’ ability to scale based on the audience’s reach in combination with the campaign’s other parameters and settings. Learn more about these features below.

#### Pre-campaign forecasting in the Campaigns app

Each time you create a new campaign or edit an existing one, you can select **Run Campaign Estimations** to generate forecasts based on the targeting rules you add to the campaign. These include the approximate size of your targetable audience, estimated reach and impressions, and the number of impressions you can expect to win at different bid prices. Refer to [Estimate reach, impression and audience size for a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7883438-estimate-reach-impression-and-audience-size-for-a-campaign) for more information on generating campaign forecasts in the Campaigns app.

#### During-campaign and post-campaign reporting in the Insights app

You can assess a campaign’s bid rate by generating a Campaign Bidding Insights report in the Insights app. The charts and figures included in the report highlight the following campaign details:

- What impact each targeting rule had on bid-request drop offs for a campaign?
- How many bid requests remained and passed through each subsequent stage?
- What final bid rate your campaign achieved after it honored each of the targeting rules you defined?

Refer to[Generate and interpret a Campaign Bidding Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10034144-generate-and-interpret-a-campaign-bidding-insights-report) to assess a campaign’s bid rate, and pinpoint which targeting parameters are causing the biggest drop off in your campaign’s bid requests.

## Troubleshoot Lookalike audience targeting issues

### New campaign - Unable to select a PG campaign type

PG campaigns aren’t eligible for Lookalike audience targeting. When you create a new campaign that will target the Lookalike audience, the **Advanced** option is selected by default, and the **PG** option is disabled.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to a PG campaign

Only **Advanced** campaigns are eligible for targeting Lookalike audiences. For this reason, the **Audiences** section is intentionally excluded from **PG** campaigns.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to an Advanced campaign

Campaigns typically support targeting multiple audience types. Healthcare advertisers should note, however, that a single campaign can never target both NPI-based and non-NPI-based audiences. For example, a campaign can’t target a Retargeted audience consisting of your website’s past visitors if it’s already targeting an HCP Geofarmed audience.

If the campaign isn’t targeting conflicting audience types, confirm how many audiences it’s targeting instead. One campaign can target up to 20 audiences.

### Existing campaign - Campaign is missing from list

If you’re attempting to add the Lookalike audience to an existing campaign, and that campaign isn’t available in the **Campaigns** list, the campaign isn’t eligible for Lookalike audience targeting. Refer to [Lookalike audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview#h_2a84cf69b8) for more details.

### Add To Campaign button is disabled

The **Add To Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting and/or none of your campaigns are currently eligible.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Lookalike audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview#h_2a84cf69b8) for more details.

### Create Campaign button is disabled

The **Create Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Lookalike audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview#h_2a84cf69b8) for more details.

### Lookalike campaign is pacing behind

Depending on a Lookalike audience’s **Reach**, you may need to target additional audiences to a campaign to help ensure that it has enough data to [pace](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8672915-pacing-overview) appropriately. Note that the actual addressable audience will also become smaller as you apply additional targeting rules and other settings to your campaign.

We recommend applying forecasting and reporting methods to determine whether a Lookalike campaign is expected to spend its budget in full. Refer to [Other campaign targeting considerations](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497708-campaign-targeting-guide#h_8b32ef79d4) to leverage your preferred tools in the Campaigns, Planner, Reports, and Insights app and right-size your Lookalike campaign strategy. You can also review [Troubleshoot a campaign that’s pacing behind](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10471960-troubleshoot-a-campaign-that-s-pacing-behind) to rule out other facts that may impact the campaign’s pacing performance.

## Locate additional Lookalike audience resources

- [Lookalike audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6966832-lookalike-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage a Lookalike audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7019248-create-or-manage-a-lookalike-audience)

title: Create or manage a Retargeted audience

blocks.text: Retargeted audiences consist of individuals who have visited your website where a [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) was installed, and during the [data collection period](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_9c82625517) you defined. Depending on your campaign objectives, you can target or block the Retargeted audience based on their previous engagement with your brand.

Refer to [Retargeted audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview) for more information and eligibility requirements, or continue reading to create and manage a Retargeted audience in the IQM platform.
You can create one Retargeted audience at a time in the Audiences app. Follow these steps to create a new Retargeted audience:
Open the Audiences app.
Select **Retargeted Audience**.
Click **+ Create New**. This will open the **Create Retargeted Audience** pop-up window.
Enter a name for the audience.
To set a data collection period spanning a specific date range:
Select **Dates**.
Open the **Data Collection Period** date fields.
Make your starting and ending date selections and click **Apply**.
To set a data collection period spanning a specific number of months:
Select **Months**.
Open the **Data Collection Period** menu and make your selection of up to 12 months.
Click **Create**.

Creating the audience will automatically redirect you to the **Integrate Tag** screen, which includes a [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) and step-by-step instructions to integrate the Pixel Script Code.

Use the **Retargeted Audience** page of the Audiences app to review, search, sort, or filter your existing Retargeted audiences. You can also use this page to obtain or send the Pixel Script Code; or edit or delete Retargeted audiences; and assign them to campaigns.
Follow these steps to locate and review an existing Retargeted audience:
Locate the audience you’d like to review.
Search by **ID** or **Audience Name**.
Open the column selector to add or remove a table column.
Select the desired audience ID in the **ID** column. This will open the audience in a pop-up window, where you can review its details.
Once the Retargeted audience features a **Ready** status, you can review additional details.
Review the details you entered when you created the audience such as the **Data Collection Period**.
Review the audience’s **Reach**, **Cost (CPM)**, and **Status** in the summary panel.
Locate the **Pixel Code Preview** and copy it to your clipboard.
Select **Done** to close the pop-up window and return to the **Retargeted Audience** page.

When you create a new Retargeted audience, we’ll automatically redirect you to the **Integrate Tag** screen, which includes a [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) and step-by-step instructions to integrate the Pixel Script Code.
Refer to Review a Retargeted audience to obtain a Pixel Script Code for a Retargeted audience that you previously created.

**More on a website’s header section:** The header section immediately follows “<head>” in a website’s code. The “<head>” element is a container that stores information that isn’t directly displayed to the end user. For example, it can include a tracking pixel, define webpage styles and scripts, and determine other metadata. You can locate the “<head>” element by reviewing the code placed between the “<html>” tag and the “<body>” tag.

blocks.table_reason: boxed note: one text cell, or a bold label cell plus a text cell

blocks.text: Follow these steps to integrate the Pixel Script Code, and refer to the simplified representation of what your header might look like in the code snippet shown above.
Obtain the Pixel Script Code and copy it to your clipboard.
Locate the header section of the website’s code. If you’re using a CMS or web platform to manage the site, locate the header template instead.
Locate the section’s closing tag, “</head>”.
Paste the code directly above “</head>”.
By placing the code here, you’ll ensure that the script loads early in the page’s overall rendering process. This allows the pixel to collect data efficiently.
If installed correctly, the pixel will immediately begin firing and collecting user-visit data. However, note that it may take up to two hours for pixel fires to reflect in the IQM platform.
Follow these steps to send a Pixel Script Code and integration instructions to up to 15 recipients:
Select the checkbox next to the desired audience.
Click **Integrate tag**. This will open the **Integrate Tag** pop-up window.
You can review and send the Pixel Script Code for one Retargeted audience at a time. Selecting multiple audiences will disable the **Integrate tag** option.
Select the **Email Pixel Script Code** tab.
Enter each recipient’s email address into the **Email ID** field, separated by commas.
Click **Send** to share the Pixel Script Code and installation instructions.
Select **Done** to close the window and return to the **Retargeted Audience** page.

**Audience-edit notice:** The edits you apply to an existing audience will automatically be reflected in the campaigns you’ve assigned it to. These changes may affect the performance of those campaigns.
Follow these steps to edit an existing Retargeted audience:
Select the pencil icon from the desired audience’s **Actions** column. This will open the **Edit Retargeted Audience** pop-up window.
Follow the steps outlined in Create a Retargeted audience to apply your desired changes.
Select **Save** to apply the changes to the existing Retargeted audience.
While you can edit or delete existing Retargeted audiences, duplication isn’t supported because each Retargeted audience includes a unique Pixel Script Code.

# Create or manage a Retargeted audience

## Retargeted audience overview

Retargeted audiences consist of individuals who have visited your website where a [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) was installed, and during the [data collection period](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_9c82625517) you defined. Depending on your campaign objectives, you can target or block the Retargeted audience based on their previous engagement with your brand.

Refer to [Retargeted audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview) for more information and eligibility requirements, or continue reading to create and manage a Retargeted audience in the IQM platform.

## Create a Retargeted audience

You can create one Retargeted audience at a time in the Audiences app. Follow these steps to create a new Retargeted audience:

1. Open the Audiences app.
2. Select **Retargeted Audience**.
3. Click **+ Create New**. This will open the **Create Retargeted Audience** pop-up window.
4. Enter a name for the audience.
5. To set a data collection period spanning a specific date range:
   1. Select **Dates**.
   2. Open the **Data Collection Period** date fields.
   3. Make your starting and ending date selections and click **Apply**.
6. To set a data collection period spanning a specific number of months:
   1. Select **Months**.
   2. Open the **Data Collection Period** menu and make your selection of up to 12 months.
7. Click **Create**.

Creating the audience will automatically redirect you to the **Integrate Tag** screen, which includes a [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) and step-by-step instructions to integrate the Pixel Script Code.

## Manage a Retargeted audience

Use the **Retargeted Audience** page of the Audiences app to review, search, sort, or filter your existing Retargeted audiences. You can also use this page to obtain or send the Pixel Script Code; or edit or delete Retargeted audiences; and assign them to campaigns.

### Review a Retargeted audience

Follow these steps to locate and review an existing Retargeted audience:

1. Locate the audience you’d like to review.
   1. Search by **ID** or **Audience Name**.
   2. Open the column selector to add or remove a table column.
2. Select the desired audience ID in the **ID** column. This will open the audience in a pop-up window, where you can review its details.
3. Once the Retargeted audience features a **Ready** status, you can review additional details.
   1. Review the details you entered when you created the audience such as the **Data Collection Period**.
   2. Review the audience’s **Reach**, **Cost (CPM)**, and **Status** in the summary panel.
   3. Locate the **Pixel Code Preview** and copy it to your clipboard.
4. Select **Done** to close the pop-up window and return to the **Retargeted Audience** page.

### Obtain a Pixel Script Code

When you create a new Retargeted audience, we’ll automatically redirect you to the **Integrate Tag** screen, which includes a [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) and step-by-step instructions to integrate the Pixel Script Code.

Refer to Review a Retargeted audience to obtain a Pixel Script Code for a Retargeted audience that you previously created.

### Integrate the Pixel Script Code

> **More on a website’s header section:** The header section immediately follows “<head>” in a website’s code. The “<head>” element is a container that stores information that isn’t directly displayed to the end user. For example, it can include a tracking pixel, define webpage styles and scripts, and determine other metadata. You can locate the “<head>” element by reviewing the code placed between the “<html>” tag and the “<body>” tag.

Follow these steps to integrate the Pixel Script Code, and refer to the simplified representation of what your header might look like in the code snippet shown above.

1. Obtain the Pixel Script Code and copy it to your clipboard.
2. Locate the header section of the website’s code. If you’re using a CMS or web platform to manage the site, locate the header template instead.
3. Locate the section’s closing tag, “</head>”.
4. Paste the code directly above “</head>”.
   1. By placing the code here, you’ll ensure that the script loads early in the page’s overall rendering process. This allows the pixel to collect data efficiently.

If installed correctly, the pixel will immediately begin firing and collecting user-visit data. However, note that it may take up to two hours for pixel fires to reflect in the IQM platform.

### Send the Pixel Script Code

Follow these steps to send a Pixel Script Code and integration instructions to up to 15 recipients:

1. Select the checkbox next to the desired audience.
2. Click **Integrate tag**. This will open the **Integrate Tag** pop-up window.
   1. You can review and send the Pixel Script Code for one Retargeted audience at a time. Selecting multiple audiences will disable the **Integrate tag** option.
3. Select the **Email Pixel Script Code** tab.
4. Enter each recipient’s email address into the **Email ID** field, separated by commas.
5. Click **Send** to share the Pixel Script Code and installation instructions.
6. Select **Done** to close the window and return to the **Retargeted Audience** page.

### Edit a Retargeted audience

> **Audience-edit notice:** The edits you apply to an existing audience will automatically be reflected in the campaigns you’ve assigned it to. These changes may affect the performance of those campaigns.

Follow these steps to edit an existing Retargeted audience:

1. Select the pencil icon from the desired audience’s **Actions** column. This will open the **Edit Retargeted Audience** pop-up window.
2. Follow the steps outlined in Create a Retargeted audience to apply your desired changes.
3. Select **Save** to apply the changes to the existing Retargeted audience.

### Duplicate a Retargeted audience

While you can edit or delete existing Retargeted audiences, duplication isn’t supported because each Retargeted audience includes a unique Pixel Script Code.

Follow the steps outlined in Create a Retargeted audience to generate a new Retargeted audience, which also creates a new Pixel Script Code that you can install to begin capturing users.

### Delete a Retargeted audience

> **Audience deletion notice:** Note that deleted audiences are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent.

You can delete Retargeted audiences individually or in bulk. They must feature a **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** status; and their **Allowlist/Blocklist** count must be **0**.

Follow these steps to delete a Retargeted audience.

1. To delete audiences individually, use the **Actions** column to select the trash can icon next to the individual audience that you’d like to delete
2. To delete audiences in bulk:
   1. Select the checkboxes next to the desired audiences.
   2. Click **Delete**.

The deleted audience(s) will no longer appear in the Audiences app.

## Assign a Retargeted audience to a campaign

Retargeted audiences can be assigned to new and existing campaigns, and from the Audiences and Campaigns apps. Refer to [Assign an audience to a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497815-assign-an-audience-to-a-campaign) for step-by-step instructions.

## Locate additional Retargeted audience resources

- [Retargeted audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview)
- [Troubleshoot a Retargeted audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11750322-troubleshoot-a-retargeted-audience)

# Troubleshoot a Retargeted audience

## Retargeted audience troubleshooting overview

All advertisers can create and target Retargeted audience segments if their account and campaign meet certain eligibility criteria. If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating, managing, or targeting a Retargeted audience, refer to these resources first:

- [Retargeted audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage a Retargeted audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11750312-create-or-manage-a-retargeted-audience)

Return to this article to address and resolve other issues that you may encounter related to Retargeted audiences.

## Troubleshoot Retargeted audience creation or management issues

### Unable to duplicate an audience

While you can edit or delete existing Retargeted audiences, duplication isn’t supported because each Retargeted audience includes a unique Pixel Script Code.

Follow the steps outlined in [Create a Retargeted audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11750312-create-or-manage-a-retargeted-audience#h_9647ef428e) to generate a new Pixel Script Code that you can install to begin capturing users in your new Retargeted audience.

### Unable to edit an audience

You can edit **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** Retargeted audiences; however, bulk edits aren’t currently supported. Ensure that you select only one Retargeted audience at a time before attempting to edit those audiences.

Note that selecting an audience will open its details, but won’t enable any fields for editing. Instead, follow the steps outlined in [Edit a Retargeted audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11750312-create-or-manage-a-retargeted-audience#h_a68ccad425) to apply and save changes to an audience element.

### Unable to delete an audience

You can delete audiences individually or in bulk. Every selected audience must be unassigned from all campaigns before you can delete them.

You can easily reference whether an audience is assigned to any campaigns in the **Allowlist/Blocklist** column. Audiences with an **Allowlist/Blocklist** value of **0** can be deleted.

### Unable to locate a deleted audience

Deleted audiences are automatically removed from the Audiences app as soon as you complete this action. For this reason, none of the Retargeted audiences listed in the Audiences app will feature a **Deleted** status.

### Unable to review audience reach

Audience reach details will generate automatically once the [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) was successfully installed and begins firing. Note that the activity may take a few hours to reflect in the IQM platform.

### Audience reach is zero

Audience reach details will generate automatically once the [Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_228a7dff7e) was successfully installed and begins firing. Refer to [Integrate the Pixel Script Code](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11750312-create-or-manage-a-retargeted-audience#h_b69fcf6ce0) to confirm that you’ve successfully installed the code, and check [Review a Retargeted audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11750312-create-or-manage-a-retargeted-audience#h_14404f5078) to confirm whether the data collection period for this audience has begun.

If you’ve confirmed that you successfully installed the Pixel Script Code, note that the activity may take a few hours to reflect in the IQM platform.

## Troubleshoot Retargeted audience targeting issues

### New campaign - Unable to select a PG campaign type

PG campaigns aren’t eligible for Retargeted audience targeting. When you create a new campaign that will target the Retargeted audience, the **Advanced** option is selected by default, and the **PG** option is disabled.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to a PG campaign

Only **Advanced** campaigns are eligible for targeting Retargeted audiences. For this reason, the **Audiences** section is intentionally excluded from **PG** campaigns.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to an Advanced campaign

Campaigns typically support targeting multiple audience types. Healthcare advertisers should note, however, that a single campaign can never target both NPI-based and non-NPI-based audiences. For example, a campaign can’t target a Retargeted audience consisting of your website’s past visitors if it’s already targeting an HCP Geofarmed audience.

If the campaign isn’t targeting conflicting audience types, confirm how many audiences it’s targeting instead. One campaign can target up to 20 audiences.

### Existing campaign - Campaign is missing from list

If you’re attempting to add the Retargeted audience to an existing campaign, and that campaign isn’t available in the **Campaigns** list, the campaign isn’t eligible for Retargeted audience targeting. Refer to [Retargeted audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_77110c6fbd) for more details.

### Add To Campaign button is disabled

The **Add To Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting and/or none of your campaigns are currently eligible.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Retargeted audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_77110c6fbd) for more details.

### Create Campaign button is disabled

The **Create Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [Retargeted audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview#h_77110c6fbd) for more details.

### Retargeting campaign is pacing behind

Depending on a Retargeted audience’s **Reach**, you may need to target additional audiences to a campaign to help ensure that it has enough data to [pace](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8672915-pacing-overview) appropriately. Note that the actual addressable audience will also become smaller as you apply additional targeting rules and other settings to your campaign.

We recommend applying forecasting and reporting methods to determine whether a Retargeted campaign is expected to spend its budget in full. Refer to [Other campaign targeting considerations](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497708-campaign-targeting-guide#h_8b32ef79d4) to leverage your preferred tools in the Campaigns, Planner, Reports, and Insights app and right-size your Retargeted campaign strategy. You can also review [Troubleshoot a campaign that’s pacing behind](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10471960-troubleshoot-a-campaign-that-s-pacing-behind) to rule out other facts that may impact the campaign’s pacing performance.

## Locate additional Retargeted audience resources

- [Retargeted audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651485-retargeted-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage a Retargeted audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11750312-create-or-manage-a-retargeted-audience)

heading_path: Troubleshoot Geofarmed audience creation or management issues

blocks.text: The more narrow your audience settings, the fewer users will be added to that audience. If the specific locations you chose are non-negotiable and can’t be expanded, we recommend loosening the audience’s Frequency, Frequency Type, and Date Range settings.

Consider also using forecasting and reporting tools to determine your campaigns’ ability to scale based on the audience’s reach in combination with the campaign’s other parameters and settings. Learn more about these features below.

sections.heading: Pre-campaign forecasting tools
heading_path: Troubleshoot Geofarmed audience creation or management issues

blocks.text: **Forecast in the Campaigns app:** Each time you create a new campaign or edit an existing one, you can select Run Campaign Estimations to generate forecasts based on the targeting rules you add to the campaign. These include the approximate size of your targetable audience, estimated reach and impressions, and the number of impressions you can expect to win at different bid prices. Refer to [Estimate reach, impression and audience size for a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7883438-estimate-reach-impression-and-audience-size-for-a-campaign) for more information on generating campaign forecasts in the Campaigns app.

**Forecast in the Planner app:** Planner proposals give you powerful insights into your media plan’s potential reach and impressions as you layer each targeting parameter onto your campaigns, including your Geofarmed audiences. This process helps highlight which rules will limit your strategy’s scale the most. You can pre-optimize your audience and targeting details to help ensure each campaign spends in full. Refer to [Create or manage a Planner proposal](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10104761-create-or-manage-a-planner-proposal) to learn how to add your targeting criteria to a new media plan.

sections.heading: During-campaign and post-campaign reporting tools
