# Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign

## HCP Planner troubleshooting overview

You’ll need to follow specific steps and meet certain requirements to successfully create a Healthcare Professional (HCP) plan in the Planner app and generate its campaigns. If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing plans and campaigns, refer to these resources first:

- [Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview)
- [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan)
- [Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12239074-generate-a-campaign-from-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan)

Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage HCP plans.

## Plan creation troubleshooting

### Maximum campaign limit exceeded

You’ll receive an error message when your current plan-form entries will produce too many campaigns.

You likely added too many Split Strategy customizations, and/or multiple audience types, creative types, and/or device types. While this segmentation allows you to create more precise campaigns, too many selections can cause you to exceed the maximum limit of 250 campaigns.

Follow these steps to address the issue:

1. Review and adjust the plan’s **Split Strategy**. While every plan’s campaigns are segmented by **Creative Type**, **NPI Type**, and **(Data) Partner** by default; you can manage the plan’s Device Type and/or Audience Type **Split Strategy**.
2. Change your selections in the plan’s **Audience**, **Creative Types**, and/or **Device Types**, as needed.
3. Click **Refresh** following each change to help ensure the updates you apply will achieve the intended reach and scale.

If certain targeting rules are non-negotiable, consider splitting them across two plans to help ensure the maximum limit of 250 campaigns is not exceeded.

### Next button is disabled

The **Next** button becomes enabled when all of the current page’s required fields are completed. If this option is disabled, then one or more required fields are incomplete. All required fields are marked with a red asterisk and must be completed before you can proceed to the plan’s next step.

### Plan generation failed

In certain cases, your plan will fail to generate after you select **Create Plan**. The plan will remain in **Draft** status until you successfully generate it.

Follow these steps if your plan fails to generate:

1. Confirm that you’ve correctly completed all required fields in the plan. These fields are marked with an asterisk symbol. Refer to [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) for step-by-step instructions on completing required and optional fields.
2. Select **Create Plan** again to rule out a technical error, such as your browser timing out or your device losing internet connection.
3. Leave the plan input form page and return to try again:
   1. Click **Save As Draft**.
   2. Open the Planner app.
   3. Select the plan draft to open it.
   4. Click **Create Plan**.

Contact your IQM support representative if your proposal fails to generate after following these steps.

### Plan stuck in processing status

When you generate campaigns from your HCP plan, we sync them with IQM’s campaign management tools and ensure that all of your targeting rules are applied. This process typically takes approximately one hour to complete.

Contact your IQM account representative if your plan fails to finish processing after this duration.

### Plan Information section

#### Unable to select past dates

You can only select a future Start Date and End Date because the HCP plan is forward-looking: You’ll use it to generate a customized media plan tailored to your campaigns’ objectives and targeting rules.

If you’d like to generate and review performance data for past campaigns instead, you can do so via the Reports app and Insights app.

### Locations section

#### Targetable locations limited to United States

The plan will target the United States by default. You can add more granular location-targeting rules by selecting options such as **State**, **County**, **City**, and **ZIP Code**. Non-US targeting is not currently supported for HCP plans.

#### Targetable locations limited to “OR” relationship

HCP plans apply an “OR” relationship to all location targeting selections. This means that your campaign will target a user if they’re located in any of the geographic locations you chose, as long as all other campaign targeting criteria are met.

### Audience Method section

#### Unable to select preferred data partner

A data partner’s **Reach** metric is the maximum number of unique users that you can reach by targeting the audience when no other targeting rules or campaign settings are applied. HCP plans require that a data partner’s **Reach** and **Incremental Reach** metric equal or exceed **10** before you can select them.

If the **Data Partner** section is missing from your plan, that’s because you chose only the **Existing Audience** Audience Method. You previously made your data-partner selections when you initially generated those audiences in the Audiences app.

#### Existing Audience - Audience is missing from list

A given audience will populate in the **Select Audience** list when two conditions are met: It matches the **Type(s)** you selected (Matched, Segmented, Geofarmed, Contextual, and/or Account Based), and it’s an NPI-based audience. The audience must also feature a **Draft**, **Processing**, or **Ready** status.

#### Unable to select preferred Audience Method in step 2

The audiences you create or add in step 2 are based on your **Audience Method** selections in step 1 of the plan-creation process. Return to the previous page and ensure your preferred **Audience Method** (Filter Audience, Upload NPI List, Account Based, Existing Audience) is selected before proceeding to step 2.

### Inventory section

#### No Inventory Groups are shown

You’ll need to create an inventory group in the Inventory app before you can add it to your proposal. That inventory group must also have a known Reach greater than zero.

If you haven’t created an inventory group, refer to [Inventory groups overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview) for more details, and [Create or manage an inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9616211-create-or-manage-an-inventory-group) for step-by-step instructions. HCP plans support [Open Exchange inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) and [Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff).

#### PMP inventory groups are missing

HCP plans support only [Open Exchange inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) and [Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff). Refer to [Create or manage an inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9616211-create-or-manage-an-inventory-group) for step-by-step instructions on creating a new inventory group.

#### Contextual inventory groups are missing

HCP plans support only [Open Exchange inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) and [Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff). Refer to [Create or manage an inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9616211-create-or-manage-an-inventory-group) for step-by-step instructions on creating a new inventory group.

### Plans page

#### Actions column - Unable to download a plan

You can download plans that feature a **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** status. Review [Plan statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_831c43a04f) for more information, and refer to [Download a plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan#h_3100ed9115) for step-by-step instructions.

#### Unable to edit, duplicate, or delete a plan

Note that a plan must feature:

- A **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** status to be eligible for editing.
- A **Draft**, **Ready**, **Processing**, **IO Created**, or **Failed** status to be eligible for duplicating.
- A **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** status to be eligible for deleting.

If the HCP plan you’d like to manage meets the status criteria, but you’re still unable to make your desired changes, check that you haven’t selected multiple plans. You can edit, duplicate, or download only one plan at a time; or delete multiple at a time.

Refer to [Plan statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_831c43a04f) for more information.

## HCP campaign generation troubleshooting

### Campaign’s time zone is locked

Each campaign’s date range uses the same time zone as the one you chose when you initially created the HCP plan. You can still edit Start Dates and End Dates in an HCP plan’s draft or in the **Campaigns** section of a generated plan.

### IO creation failed

In certain cases, your campaigns may fail to generate after you select **Create IO**. This error is typically related to a technical issue. For example, your IQM login or device’s browser may have timed out.

Refresh your browser and select **Generate Again** from the **Plans** page.

### Unable to choose which campaigns to generate

We’ll generate all of your proposal’s campaigns when you select **Create IO**. To limit the campaigns we generate, you can select the checkbox next to any campaign you’d like to exclude, then click **Delete** to remove it from your HCP plan.

Note that deleted campaigns are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent.

### Unable to generate one or more campaigns

A minimum **Reach** of **10** and budget that is greater than the sum of the campaign’s Media CPM and Data CPM are required. Note that all campaigns that meet these requirements will automatically begin generating once the **Create IO** option is selected.

### Unable to change budget type (impression based, budget based)

You choose whether to create a budget-based or impression-based insertion order (IO) when you create an HCP plan. Each of the campaigns within the plan adopt the same budget type. For this reason, individual campaigns’ budget types can’t be changed once they’re processed.

## Locate additional HCP Planner resources

- [Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12239074-generate-a-campaign-from-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan)

# Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan

## Campaign generation overview

The plans you create in the HCP Planner app define a single, unified media plan across devices and channels to maximize the reach and impact of your healthcare campaigns. Once you choose which of the proposal’s campaigns you’d like to generate, you can easily transition from planning to execution by finishing campaign setup in the Campaigns app.

If you’d like to add or edit individual campaigns before generating campaigns from them, first refer to [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) for step-by-step instructions.

## Generate campaigns from a plan

> **Choosing which campaigns to generate:** A minimum **Reach** of **10**, and a budget higher than the sum of the campaign’s media cost and data cost, are required. For example, a minimum campaign budget of $15 is required if the media cost is $5 and the data cost is $10. If these conditions are met, all of a plan’s campaigns will begin generating when you select **Create IO**. If desired, you can exclude individual campaigns by deleting them from the plan. Follow the steps outlined in [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) to complete this step. Note that deleted campaigns are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent. As a safeguard, consider duplicating a plan before deleting any campaigns from it. Refer to[Delete a campaign from a plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan#h_09a03f77ca) for more information.

Note that a plan must feature a **Ready** status for its campaigns to be eligible for generation. Refer to [Plan statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_831c43a04f) for more information.

You can activate an HCP plan’s campaigns in the following ways:

- From the **Plans** page
- From within the selected plan

### Create the IO from the Plans page

Follow these steps to generate the plan’s campaigns from the **Plans** page of the Planner app:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **HCP**.
3. Locate the desired plan on the **Plans** page.
   1. If you’ve created several plans, search by a plan element (ID, Name, Created By) or filter by status to limit which plans will display on the page.
4. Select **Create IO** in the **Actions** column next to the plan. This will open a pop-up window, which you can use to review a summary of the plan’s campaigns and confirm that you’d like to activate them.
5. Check that neither the plan’s **Start Date** or **End Date** is in the past.
   1. Update the applicable field(s) to today’s date or a future date, if necessary.
6. Click **Create IO**.

The plan’s status will change from **Ready** to **Processing** while we work on generating the campaigns, then from **Processing** to **IO Created** when the process is complete. You can view and manage generated campaigns once they reach an **IO Created** status.

Note that each generated campaign will remain as a draft until you add your creatives and choose to run them.

### Create the IO from the Plan Details page

Follow these steps to generate the plan’s campaigns from within the selected plan in the Planner app:

1. Select the plan’s name in the **Name** column. This will open the plan.
2. Click **Next** on each page until you reach the final **6 out of 6 steps** page.
3. Select **Create IO**.

The plan’s status will change from **Ready** to **Processing** while we work on generating the campaigns, then from **Processing** to **IO Created** when the process is complete. You can view and manage generated campaigns once they reach an **IO Created** status.

Note that each generated campaign will remain as a draft until you add your creatives and choose to run them.

## Manage generated campaigns

You’ll need to add your creative(s) to your campaigns before you can run them. You can review or manage campaigns that you generated from an HCP Planner plan in the following ways:

- From the **Plans** page of the Planner app - Shortcut to Campaigns app
- From the **Plan Details** page of the Planner app - Shortcut to Campaigns app
- From the Campaigns app

> **Save time with bulk actions:** If you plan to apply the same creative to multiple campaigns, assign it from the **Creatives** app. Simply open the app, select the checkbox next to the creative, and click **Assign To Campaign**. Search and select individual campaigns, or select the insertion order (IO) to add the creative to every campaign within that IO. Click **Assign** and return to the **Campaigns** app when you’re ready to run your campaigns.

### Manage generated campaigns from the Plans page - Planner app

Follow these steps to manage generated campaigns from the **Plans** page of the Planner app:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **HCP**.
3. Locate the desired plan on the **Plans** page.
   1. If you’ve created several plans, search by a plan element (ID, Name, Created By) or filter by status to limit which plans will display on the page.
4. Select **View Campaigns** in the **Actions** column next to the plan. This will redirect you to the **Insertion Order Info** page of the **Campaigns** app.
5. Select a campaign from the **Campaign Name** column to open its detail page.
6. Locate and expand the Creative section. The creative formats you chose in your HCP Planner plan are pre-selected.
7. Click **+ Select Creatives** to add a creative you’ve already uploaded to the **Creatives** app, or **+ New Creative** to add a new one.
8. The remaining sections of the campaign automatically include each of the inputs you specified in your plan. You can review and update these items or any other section of the campaign, if desired.
   1. Any changes applied to the campaign will impact the values previously forecasted in your HCP Planner plan.
9. Select **Run** to run the campaign.

### Manage generated campaigns from the Plan Details page - Planner app

Follow these steps to manage generated campaigns from the **Plan Details** page of the Planner app:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **HCP**.
3. Locate the desired plan on the **Plans** page.
   1. If you’ve created several plans, search by a plan element (ID, Name, Created By) or filter by status to limit which plans will display on the page.
4. Select the plan’s name in the **Name** column. This will redirect you to the plan.
5. Select **View Campaigns**. This will redirect you to the **Insertion Order Info** page of the **Campaigns** app.
6. Follow steps 5 through 9 of the Manage generated campaigns from the Plans page - Planner app workflow.

### Manage generated campaigns from the Campaigns app

Follow these steps to manage generated campaigns from the **Insertion Order Info** page of the Campaigns app:

1. Open the Campaigns app.
2. Search or browse the page to locate the desired insertion order (IO). Its name will match the name of the HCP plan you created in the Planner app.
3. Select the IO’s name. This will redirect you to the **Insertion Order Info** page.
4. Follow steps 5 through 9 of the Manage generated campaigns from the Planner app - Plans page workflow.

## Reference associated campaigns

You can quickly reference which campaigns are associated with an HCP plan directly from the Planner app. Note that this option is available only for plans featuring an **IO Created** status.

Follow these steps to reference associated campaigns:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **HCP**.
3. Locate the desired plan on the **Plans** page.
   1. If you’ve created several plans, search by a plan element (ID, Name, Created By) or filter by status to limit which plans will display on the page.
4. Select the listed value in the **Campaigns** column. This will open a pop-up window that lists each of the plan’s campaigns and their details.
5. If desired, select any campaign from the **Campaign Name** column. This will open its details page in the Campaigns app, where you can review and manage it.

## Locate additional HCP Planner resources

- [Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview)
- [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan#h_3bfcfcd40d)
- [Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238998-troubleshoot-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan-or-campaign#h_72bc5eb24a)

title: Optimization & Delivery frequently asked questions (FAQ)

blocks.text: When you create a campaign, you’ll choose whether you’d like to apply manual optimizations ([Rule Based Optimization](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10906959-optimization-delivery-overview#h_7ba6f52bdf)) or let the IQM platform’s AI engine automatically apply optimizations that aim to achieve the campaign’s primary objective and goal ([AI Based Optimization](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10906959-optimization-delivery-overview#h_4753688f6d)). You also have the option to apply Frequency Capping, Bid Pacing, and Budget Capping.

While all advertisers can create campaigns with either AI Based Optimization or Rule Based Optimization enabled, each campaign must meet certain eligibility requirements. If you encounter an error or experience questions related to Optimization & Delivery, refer to these resources first:
[Optimization & Delivery overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10906959-optimization-delivery-overview)
[Manage a campaign’s Optimization & Delivery settings](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651517-manage-a-campaign-s-optimization-delivery-settings)
Return to this article to address and resolve other factors related to a campaign’s Delivery & Optimization section.
**Q: What happens if Bid Shading and Advanced Modeling are enabled at the same time?**

**A:** Bid Shading is compatible with the [Spend Ratio](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9298415-spend-ratio-overview) and [Priority](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9298440-priority-overview) Bid Model settings. The [Bid Modifier](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9298560-bid-modifier-overview) Bid Model setting cannot be applied at the same time as the Bid Shading feature.
**Q: Why can’t I enable Advanced Modeling for my campaign?**

**A:** While selecting Rule Based Optimization does give you access to the IQM platform’s Advanced Modeling feature, the campaign must meet certain requirements before you can enable it. Refer to [Bid Model overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10870472-bid-model-overview) for more information related to eligibility criteria.

A campaign’s Optimization & Delivery settings determine how aggressively it should bid based on how much you’d like to spend, how you’d like to pace bidding, and how often you’d like for users to see an ad. Refer to [Optimization & Delivery overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10906959-optimization-delivery-overview) for more information.

**Q: How do I enable Bid Pacing for a campaign?**

**A:** Refer to the steps outlined in [Manage a campaign’s Optimization & Delivery settings](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651517-manage-a-campaign-s-optimization-delivery-settings) to complete this process.

## Budget Capping FAQ

**Q: Is Budget Capping compatible with both AI Based and Rule Based Optimization?**

**A:** Yes. You set and manage Budget Capping settings for a campaign regardless of whether AI Based or Rule Based Optimization are selected.

**Q: When does Budget Capping management take place?**

**A:** You can enable optional Budget Capping settings when you complete a campaign’s **Optimization & Delivery** section. A campaign’s Optimization & Delivery settings determine how aggressively it should bid based on how much you’d like to spend, how you’d like to pace bidding, and how often you’d like for users to see an ad. Refer to [Optimization & Delivery overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10906959-optimization-delivery-overview) for more information.

**Q: How do I add my Budget Capping setting to a campaign?**

**A:** Refer to the steps outlined in [Manage a campaign’s Optimization & Delivery settings](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651517-manage-a-campaign-s-optimization-delivery-settings) to complete this process.

**Q: When does it make sense to apply Budget Capping?**

**A:** Since impression and budget caps cause your campaign to stop spending once the daily limits are reached, we recommend reserving these settings for campaigns and IOs that are pacing on track (90%-100%) or pacing ahead (100%-120%). You might also consider increasing a budget cap to allow the campaign’s pacing to catch up. Refer to [Pacing overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8672915-pacing-overview) for more information on how pacing performance is calculated, and how it differs for budget-based and impression-based campaigns.

# Manage a user's account security settings

## Account security overview

> **More on account security:** Only Admin, Workspace Owners, Advertiser Owners, Default Users, and Full-Access users can manage the MFA settings of other users. Use only when required.

Providing at least two different forms of identification when logging into any online account can make it significantly harder for hackers to access it.

The IQM platform supports Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to add an extra layer of security to your account. This feature requires users to verify their identity by entering their password and a one-time verification code sent to their email.

Workspace Owners and Advertiser Owners can manage MFA security settings for users linked to their accounts in the Organization app, and individual users can manage MFA security settings for their own account in the My Profile app. The most recent MFA settings configured by any user type will reflect across the account; in other words, any existing settings will be overwritten.

## Enable or disable MFA - Organization

You can enable or disable MFA settings for users in the following ways:

- One by one for individual users
- In bulk for multiple users

### Enable or disable MFA for individual users

Follow these steps to manage MFA settings for one user at a time:

1. Select the **Profile** tab of the Organization app.
2. Click **Security Settings**.
3. In the **MFA Status** column, select the toggle switch to change to enable or disable MFA for a user.

### Enable or disable MFA for multiple users

Follow these steps to manage MFA settings for multiple users at a time:

1. Select the **Profile** tab of the Organization app.
2. Click **Security Settings**.
3. Select the checkboxes next to the desired users.
4. Click **Enable MFA** or **Disable MFA** to enable or disabled MFA for the selected users.

## Enable or disable MFA - My Profile

Follow these steps to manage MFA settings for your own account:

1. Open the My Profile app.
2. Select the **Account Details** tab.
3. In the **Security Settings** section, select the toggle switch to change to enable or disable MFA. This will open the **Update Multi-Factor Authentication** pop-up window.
4. Confirm your updated MFA settings.

## Log in with an MFA verification code

When MFA is enabled for your account, you’ll be prompted to enter a one-time verification code to confirm your identity when you log in.

Follow these steps to log in with an MFA verification code:

1. Enter your email ID.
2. Click **Next**.
3. Enter your password.
4. Click **Next**.
5. Open the email inbox that’s associated with your platform login to retrieve your one-time verification code.
   1. Check your spam folder if you didn’t receive a code.
   2. The code pictured in the sample image is for example purposes only.
6. Enter the code into the **Enter verification code** field.
7. If the code has expired, click **Resend code** to receive a new one.
8. Select **Verify identity** to finish logging in.

# Political creative approval process for publishers

## Political creative approval process overview

Certain publishers complete compliance checks before Political ads start running. To help streamline the creative review-and-approval process for these ads, they use a specific Creative Submission API. It’s a request that, once sent, returns any creatives attached to Political campaigns that include a [Federal Election Commission Identifier (FEC ID) or a state equivalent](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12003037-organization-profile-overview#h_fa4aa3286f). This process allows the publisher partners to manually review Political creatives prior to approving them.

Publisher partners complete a simple three-step process when they use an API to review Political campaign creatives:

## Obtain the right permissions (access token)

> **Client ID and Client Secret notice:** Contact your IQM representative to obtain a **ClientID** and **ClientSecret**. These items are required before you can obtain the access token and send a Creative Submission API request for Political campaign creatives.

The publisher partner will obtain client credentials, also known as the access token, to confirm they have the proper authorization to access a particular Political campaign’s creatives. They’ll send a POST API request containing the following details to ask for these credentials:

| **Section** | **Requirement type** | **Requirement details** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Header** | x-iaa-host | api.iqm.com [Global Host] |
| **Header** | Authorization* | Basic <base64(ClientID:ClientSecret)> |
| **Header** | Content-Type | application/x-www-form-urlencoded |
| **Body** | Grant-Type | grant_type=client_credentials |

*Refer to Obtain the base64 string for additional support with the Authorization header.

### Obtain the base64 string

Obtaining the base64 string for the Authorization header is a two-step process:

1. Concatenate the Client ID and Client Secret with a colon.
2. Base64-encode the result.

Refer to the example below for more information.

| **Item** | **Example value** |
| --- | --- |
| Example ClientID | Test |
| Example ClientSecret | 123456 |
| Example concatenation | Test:123456 |
| Example base64 | cm9rdV8yOjEyMzQ1Ng== |

### Example cURL request

Refer to the block below to review an example of a request to obtain the access token.

```
curl --location 'http://api.iqm.com/api/v3/ua/oauth/token' \
  --header 'x-iaa-host: api.iqm.com' \
  --header 'Authorization: Basic cm9rdV8yOjEyMzQ1Ng==' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  --data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials'
```

### Example token response

> **Access token notice:** After you successfully submit the access token request, remember to save the **access token** included in the response. You’ll need to include this token when you call the Creative Submission API.

Refer to the block below to review an example of a successful response to your access-token request. Pay special attention to the **scope**: when a response excludes the “creative.submit” scope, it means the client isn’t authorized to submit creatives via this API.

```
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJI...kVJhsWWDCL3...",
  "expires_at": 1763632934684,
  "scope": "creative.submit"
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 1799,
  "jti": "1c04c09a-67ab-4fe0-a626-a5f1475d283e"
}
```

## Request a Political campaign’s creatives

The publisher partner will use the credentials they obtained to request all of the creatives associated with a specific Political campaign. They’ll send an API request containing the following details to submit a request for these creatives. This request is called the “Creative Submission API.”

| **Section** | **Requirement type** | **Requirement details** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **API Endpoint** | URL | [http://api.iqm.com/api/v3/crt/creatives/submit](http://api.iqm.com/api/v3/crt/creatives/submit) |
| **Header** | Authorization* | Bearer <access_token> |
| **Header** | x-iaa-host | api.iqm.com |
| **Query Parameters** | Limit (Optional) | If desired, limit the number of creatives submitted. The default value is “-1”, meaning all valid creatives will be submitted when you send the API request. |

*Replace the <access_token> value with the actual access token you received.

### Example cURL request

Refer to the block below to review an example of a Creative Submission API request.

```
curl --location 'http://api.iqm.com/api/v3/crt/creatives/submit?limit=10' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>' \
  --header 'x-iaa-host: api.iqm.com'
```

### Example response

Publisher partners know that their request was successful when they receive a **200 OK** API response that includes the information shown in the example below. A successful request means that the details of the request were valid and the publisher obtained the proper authorization before sending the request.

```
{
    "success": true,
    "data": [
        {
            "creativeId": 715863,
            "creativeName": "Sample Creative Name",
            "creativeSource": "https://cdn.example.com/creatives/715863/sample-creative.jpg",
            "advertiserDetails": {
                "advertiserName": "Sample Advertiser",
                "website": "https://www.sampleadvertiser.com",
                "chiefName": "John Doe",
                "contactNumber": "+1-202-555-0147",
                "address": "123 Main Street, New York, NY 10001",
                "politicalIdentifier": "POL-45678",
                "advertiserId": 11124,
                "legalInfo": "Verified advertiser with compliance clearance",
                "links": [
                    "https://www.sampleadvertiser.com/about",
                    "https://www.sampleadvertiser.com/campaigns"
                ]
            }
        }
    ]
}
```

### Unsuccessful requests for a Political campaign’s creatives

Requests for a Political campaign’s creative details aren’t always successful. Refer to the table below for more information on errors that a publisher partner may encounter.

| **Error** | **Error description** |
| --- | --- |
| 401 Unauthorized | Either the token is missing, invalid, or expired; or the client is expired. |
| 403 Forbidden | The token is valid, but does not have the required “creative.submit” scope. This can occur if you use an access token issued for a client that isn’t otherwise authorized to submit creatives. |

## Locate additional Creatives resources

- [Creative and specifications collection](https://help.iqm.com/en/collections/1387054-creatives-and-specifications)

title: Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview

blocks.text: When healthcare advertisers evaluate how effectively their campaigns reached the right patient audiences, they’re able to bridge the gap between clinical targeting and digital media performance.

Audience Quality (AQ) Insights reports help you validate patient reach. These insights leverage third-party healthcare data from PurpleLab to confirm audience exposure based on patient-level targeting criteria including prescriptions, diagnoses, and procedures.

The IQM platform pairs these insights with an AQ Score ranging from 0% to 100%, so you’ll know exactly how well each campaign and audience is connecting with the qualified patient segments you intend to reach. Each report also includes detailed data across dimensions such as publisher, geography, and device type for more in-depth campaign-level and audience-level AQ insights.
If you’re a Healthcare advertiser, you may be eligible to generate AQ Insights reports.
The following conditions must also be met before a given campaign or audience becomes eligible for AQ Insights reporting.

PLD Insights reports help you uncover ad-exposure and engagement data, demographic data, and physician-specialty data for your NPI-based healthcare audiences; while SLS Insights reports help you evaluate the effectiveness of your healthcare campaigns based on pre- and post-campaign prescription (Rx, TRx) volumes and your competitors’ prescription patterns.

blocks.text: *If an AQ Insights report features a **Failed** status, no **AQ Insights Cost** will be deducted from the advertiser’s balance.

There is a cost associated with generating an AQ Insights report. You can reference its price after you enter key details–like the campaign’s total number of chargeable impressions and date range–and before you generate the report. We calculate these impressions on a CPM basis.

Refer to [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report) for more information on where to reference the report-price preview.

The workflow to generate an AQ Insights report ends with a **Generate** button that you’ll use to create the report. We’ll deduct the **AQ Cost** from your account’s available balance once the report successfully generates. In most cases, this will take place immediately after you select **Generate**.

Refer to [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report) for step-by-step report creation instructions.

The workflow to create an AQ Insights report typically ends with a **Generate** button that you can use to create the report. If your account’s available balance is less than the report’s **AQ Cost**, then this button will prompt you to add funds to your account instead. We’ll redirect you to enter a fund amount and select a payment method when you click **Add Funds**.
Note that you’ll need to refresh the **Audience Insights** creation widget to reflect your account’s updated balance and continue with report generation.

sections.heading: Pricing for AQ Insights reports with overlapping datasets
heading_path: Pricing for AQ Insights reports with overlapping datasets

blocks.text: There may be instances when you generate multiple AQ Insights reports with partially overlapping date ranges for the same campaign. This means that the insight data also overlaps.
You’ll pay only once for AQ Insights data for each date.

**Example:** An advertiser generates two reports for the same campaign–one with a date range of August 1st-14th, and another with a date range of August 5th-20th. Since they already paid for the insights from August 1st-14th, they’ll only be charged for a portion of the second report: the new data generated for the August 15th-20th date range. However, we’ll still aggregate data from the full August 5th-20th date range in the second report.
An Audience Quality score is determined by two metrics: The audience’s **Exposed** users and **Matched** details.

The audience’s **Exposed** metric is the total number of identified patients who were exposed to your ad. Its **Matched** metric represents the number of these users who were confirmed to be part of the qualified patient segments you intended to reach.
When you divide the Patient audience’s total number of **Matched** users by the **Exposed** users, then multiply the result by 100, you’re left with the audience’s AQ Score.
A campaign’s overall AQ Score considers each of the individual AQ Scores of its target audiences.

**Example:** A campaign served 3.3M **Impressions**, and earned an **Exposure** of 274K identified patients. Approximately 250K of these users were confirmed to be **Matched**. This campaign’s AQ Score is 91.2%. ([250K / 274K] * 100 = 91.2%).

# Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview

## AQ Insights report overview

When healthcare advertisers evaluate how effectively their campaigns reached the right patient audiences, they’re able to bridge the gap between clinical targeting and digital media performance.

Audience Quality (AQ) Insights reports help you validate patient reach. These insights leverage third-party healthcare data from PurpleLab to confirm audience exposure based on patient-level targeting criteria including prescriptions, diagnoses, and procedures.

The IQM platform pairs these insights with an AQ Score ranging from 0% to 100%, so you’ll know exactly how well each campaign and audience is connecting with the qualified patient segments you intend to reach. Each report also includes detailed data across dimensions such as publisher, geography, and device type for more in-depth campaign-level and audience-level AQ insights.

## AQ Insights report eligibility requirements

If you’re a Healthcare advertiser, you may be eligible to generate AQ Insights reports.

The following conditions must also be met before a given campaign or audience becomes eligible for AQ Insights reporting.

| **Requirement type** | **Requirement details** |
| --- | --- |
| **Campaign vertical** | Healthcare* |
| **Audience type** | [Matched (Patient)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview) [Segmented (Patient)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview) [Campaign (Patient)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7033794-campaign-audience-overview) |
| **Audience status** | Ready |
| **Campaign type** | Advanced, and targeting at least one patient audience |
| **Campaign status** | Running Expired (within the past two years) Paused |
| **Campaign impressions** | 1K or more impression |
| **Campaign duration** | 14 or more days |

***Healthcare:** Any campaign created under a healthcare advertiser account is a “Healthcare” campaign.

## AQ Insights report metrics

> **More on healthcare campaign insights:** AQ Insights reports provide in-depth data of your patient-based strategies. For NPI-based audiences, gain deeper insights with two additional healthcare measurement solutions: Provider Level Data (PLD) Insights reports and Script Lift Study (SLS) Insights reports. PLD Insights reports help you uncover ad-exposure and engagement data, demographic data, and physician-specialty data for your NPI-based healthcare audiences; while SLS Insights reports help you evaluate the effectiveness of your healthcare campaigns based on pre- and post-campaign prescription (Rx, TRx) volumes and your competitors’ prescription patterns. Refer to [PLD Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10774817-provider-level-data-pld-insights-report-overview) and [SLS Insights overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10858871-script-lift-study-sls-insights-report-overview) for more information.

The AQ Insights report includes impression, reach, and audience-matching analyses broken out by a particular dimension, including geographic location, device type, audiences, and publishers. These metrics inform an overall AQ Score to help you evaluate how effectively a given campaign reached the intended patient audience.

Review the AQ Insights report metrics below, and refer to [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report) when you’re ready to create one. The report is available in both XLS and PDF formats.

### Report Information

Review the inputs you selected during report creation, which dictate the information that’s included in the generated report.

Report Information includes the following details:
- Report ID
- Report Name
- Report Duration
- Campaign Name

### Campaign Overview

Uncover the campaign’s overall audience quality based on how many times the campaign served an ad, the number of unique users who saw it, and how many of those users match the intended patient audience.

Campaign Overview includes the following metrics:
- Total Impressions (#)
- Exposed Users (#)
- Matched Users (#)
- Overall Campaign Audience Quality (%)

### AQ Over Time

Review the campaign’s overall audience quality by date to determine whether it's trending upward, downward, or remaining the same.

AQ Over Time includes the following metrics:
- AQ Score percentage (Y-axis)
- Dates (X-axis)

### Campaign Overview by Audience

Assess the quality of the campaign’s individual audiences by date to determine whether they’re trending upward, downward, or remaining the same. Reference the graph to easily compare which audiences are most effectively reaching the intended patient audience.

Campaign Overview by Audience includes the following metrics:
- Impressions (#)
- Exposed (#)
- Matched Users (#)
- Audience Quality (%)

### Audience Quality by Audience

Gain valuable insight into each individual audience’s AQ Score and exposure data by date.

Audience Quality by Audience includes the following metrics:
- Impressions (#)
- Exposed (#)
- Matched Users (#)
- Audience Quality (%)
- Overall Audience Quality (%)

### Audience Quality by Device Type

Review details by the type of device that the ad was served on, and check each device type’s AQ Score by audience.

Audience Quality by Device Type includes the following metrics:
- Device-level Audience Quality (%) by Audience

### Audience Quality by Publisher - Top 5 by Reach

Check AQ Scores by publisher for each audience, and review charts for the five publishers with the highest reach for the campaign.

Audience Quality by Publisher includes the following metrics:
- Publisher-level Audience Quality (%) by Audience

### Audience Quality by Location - Top 5 by Reach

Check AQ Scores by targeted location for each audience, and review charts for the five locations with the highest reach for the campaign.

Audience Quality by Location includes the following metrics:
- Location-level Audience Quality (%) by Audience

## AQ Insights report statuses

You can review an AQ Insights report’s current status on the **Audience Quality** page.

| **Status** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **Ready** | Your insights are generated. You can view, download, and/or email the AQ Insights report. |
| **Processing** | We’re working on generating your insights. It may take up to 72 hours for the report to reach a **Ready** status. |
| **Failed*** | You encountered a technical error during report generation. Try again in a few minutes. |

*If an AQ Insights report features a **Failed** status, no **AQ Insights Cost** will be deducted from the advertiser’s balance.

## AQ Insights report pricing

There is a cost associated with generating an AQ Insights report. You can reference its price after you enter key details–like the campaign’s total number of chargeable impressions and date range–and before you generate the report. We calculate these impressions on a CPM basis.

Refer to [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report) for more information on where to reference the report-price preview.

### Price deduction - Sufficient funds

The workflow to generate an AQ Insights report ends with a **Generate** button that you’ll use to create the report. We’ll deduct the **AQ Cost** from your account’s available balance once the report successfully generates. In most cases, this will take place immediately after you select **Generate**.

Refer to [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report) for step-by-step report creation instructions.

### Price deduction - Insufficient funds

The workflow to create an AQ Insights report typically ends with a **Generate** button that you can use to create the report. If your account’s available balance is less than the report’s **AQ Cost**, then this button will prompt you to add funds to your account instead. We’ll redirect you to enter a fund amount and select a payment method when you click **Add Funds**.

Note that you’ll need to refresh the **Audience Insights** creation widget to reflect your account’s updated balance and continue with report generation.

### Pricing for AQ Insights reports with overlapping datasets

There may be instances when you generate multiple AQ Insights reports with partially overlapping date ranges for the same campaign. This means that the insight data also overlaps.

You’ll pay only once for AQ Insights data for each date.

**Example:** An advertiser generates two reports for the same campaign–one with a date range of August 1st-14th, and another with a date range of August 5th-20th. Since they already paid for the insights from August 1st-14th, they’ll only be charged for a portion of the second report: the new data generated for the August 15th-20th date range. However, we’ll still aggregate data from the full August 5th-20th date range in the second report.

## Key terms and concepts

### Audience Quality (AQ) Score

An Audience Quality score is determined by two metrics: The audience’s **Exposed** users and **Matched** details.

The audience’s **Exposed** metric is the total number of identified patients who were exposed to your ad. Its **Matched** metric represents the number of these users who were confirmed to be part of the qualified patient segments you intended to reach.

When you divide the Patient audience’s total number of **Matched** users by the **Exposed** users, then multiply the result by 100, you’re left with the audience’s AQ Score.

A campaign’s overall AQ Score considers each of the individual AQ Scores of its target audiences.

**Example:** A campaign served 3.3M **Impressions**, and earned an **Exposure** of 274K identified patients. Approximately 250K of these users were confirmed to be **Matched**. This campaign’s AQ Score is 91.2%. ([250K / 274K] * 100 = 91.2%).

## Locate additional AQ Insights report resources:

- [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report)
- [Troubleshoot an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132530-troubleshoot-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report)

# Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report

## AQ Insights report overview

Audience Quality (AQ) Insights reports help healthcare advertisers validate patient reach.

These reports leverage third-party data from PurpleLab to confirm audience exposure based on criteria such as prescriptions, diagnoses, and procedures. They include AQ Scores (0-100%) that indicate to what extent your campaign and its individual audiences included qualified patient segments, and feature detailed data across dimensions such as publisher, geography, and device type for deeper insights.

Refer to [Audience Quality (AQ) Insights overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview) for more information and eligibility criteria, or continue reading to create a new report.

## Generate an AQ Insights report

> **Concept Group ID notice:** You’ll choose whether to assign Concept Group IDs by campaign or by audience when you create your AQ Insights report. These IDs correlate to specific, targeted patient conditions, prescriptions, and diagnoses. Campaign-level assignment requires a single Concept Group ID, which is applied to all audiences in the campaign. Audience-level assignment, however, requires a separate Concept Group ID for each audience. IQM will provide you with the required Concept Group ID(s) for your AQ Insights report. Contact your IQM account representative prior to creating the report to ensure you have the appropriate Concept Group ID(s) for data generation.

You can generate an AQ Insights report in the following ways:

- From the Insights app
- From the Campaigns app
- From the Dashboard app

### Generate an AQ Insights report from the Insights app

Follow these steps to create new report from the Insights app:

1. Open the Insights app.
2. Click **Audience Quality**.
3. Select **+ Generate New**. This will open the **Generate Audience Quality** pop-up window.
4. Enter a name for the report.
   1. Choose a unique one to differentiate this report from others that you may create.
5. Select whether the desired campaign is **Running**, **Paused**, or **Expired**.
   1. Your selection will determine which campaigns are available in the **Campaign** menu.
6. Search and select the campaign for which you want to generate insights.
7. The **Date Range** field will automatically populate once you select a campaign.
   1. The selected range reflects the campaign’s start date through one day ago or the campaign’s end date–whichever took place first.
8. Choose campaign-level or audience-level Concept Group ID assignment.
9. Enter the applicable Concept Group ID(s).
   1. If you chose audience-level Concept Group ID assignment, note that individual Concept Group IDs are required for each audience.
10. Select **Next**.
11. Review the report’s settings, and a summary of the AQ Insights report’s chargeable impressions and the associated cost.
    1. We calculate **AQ Cost** based on the number of impressions that your campaign delivered during the specified date range at a CPM rate.
12. Select **Previous** to change any report settings, if desired.
13. Click **Generate** to create the AQ Insights report.

The **AQ Cost** will be held as soon as you select **Generate**, and deducted from your account’s available balance as soon as the report’s status changes from **Processing** to **Ready**. In some cases, this may occur immediately.

You can locate generated reports on the **Audience Quality** page. Review Manage an AQ Insights report for more details.

### Generate an AQ Insights report from the Campaigns app

You can begin AQ Insights report generation from the Campaigns app. Doing so will automatically populate certain fields such as the report’s campaign, its status, and its date range.

Follow these steps to take the shortcut from the Campaigns app:

1. Open the Campaigns app.
2. Select an insertion order (IO) to arrive at the **Insertion Order Info** page.
3. Click the checkbox next to the campaign for which you want to generate insights.
   1. You can generate AQ Insights for one campaign at a time.
4. Select **Generate AQ Insights** from the **More** menu. This will redirect you to the **Audience Quality** page of the Insights app, and auto-populate the campaign, its status, and its date range.
   1. This option is available only when your account and the selected campaign are eligible for AQ Insights reporting.
5. Follow steps 8 through 13 of the Generate an AQ Insights report from the Insights app workflow to finish creating the report.

### Generate an AQ Insights report from the Dashboard app

You can begin AQ Insights report generation from the Dashboard app. Doing so will automatically populate certain fields such as the report’s campaign, its status, and its date range.

Follow these steps to take the shortcut from the Dashboard app:

1. Open the Dashboard app.
2. Filter or search the dashboard to locate the desired campaign.
3. Click the checkbox next to the campaign.
   1. You can generate AQ Insights for one campaign at a time.
4. Select **Generate AQ Insights** from the **More** menu. This will redirect you to the **Audience Quality** page of the Insights app, and auto-populate the campaign’s status, campaign, and date range.
   1. This option is available only when your account and the selected campaign are eligible for AQ Insights reporting.
5. Follow steps 8 through 13 of the Generate an AQ Insights report from the Insights app workflow to finish creating the report.

## Manage an AQ Insights report

The **Audience Quality** page displays each of your AQ Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. Use the **Actions** column to download or email a **Ready** AQ Insights report to your device, or send it as an email attachment.

### Download an AQ Insights report

Follow these steps to download a **Ready** AQ Insights report as PDF and XLSX files:

1. Search or browse your AQ Insights reports to locate the one you’d like to download.
2. Select **Download** from the desired report’s **Actions** column.

### Send an AQ Insights report

> **Email notice:** An email will include the report as a file attachment when its size is less than 25 MB, or a link to the report when its size is greater than 25 MB. This limitation is to comply with the file-size restrictions of most email inboxes. You can Download an AQ Insights report of any size.

Follow these steps to send a **Ready** AQ Insights report’s PDF and XLSX files via email:

1. Search or browse your AQ Insights reports to locate the one you’d like to send.
2. Select the envelope icon from the desired report’s **Actions** column. This will open the **Email Audience Quality** pop-up window.
3. Enter up to 15 email aliases to the **Email ID** field, separated by commas.
4. Select **Send Email**.

### Delete an AQ Insights report

We limit the ability to delete most AQ Insights reports to help avoid accidental deletions of paid insights. You can, however, delete **Failed** reports.

Follow these steps to delete a **Failed** AQ Insights report from the **Audience Quality** page:

1. Select the checkbox(es) next to the **Failed** report(s) you want to delete.
2. Click **Delete**.

## Review past AQ Insights report spend

You can review past AQ Insights report spend in the following ways:

- From the Dashboard app
- From the Reports app

### Review past AQ Insights report spend from the Dashboard app

Follow these steps to review the total amount spent on AQ Insights report generation from the Dashboard app:

1. Open the Dashboard app.
2. Open the **View By** menu and choose **Campaigns**, **Insertion Orders**, or **Advertiser**, depending on your preference.
   1. Workspace admins also have the option to select **Workspace**.
3. Select **AQ Insights Cost** from the **Columns** menu.
   1. The **AQ Insights Cost** column will populate in the table.
   2. Workspace admins also have the option to select **Workspace AQ Insights Earnings**.
4. Adjust the dashboard’s **Time Zone** and **Date Range** details to view the amount spent on AQ Insights report generation within a specific time frame, if desired.

### Review past AQ Insights report spend from the Reports app

Follow these steps to review the total amount spent on AQ Insights report generation from the Reports app:

1. Open the Reports app.
2. Click **+ Create Report**. This will open the **Create New Report** page.
3. Locate and expand the **Spending** category.
4. Drag the **AQ Insights Cost** metric into the **Columns** field.
5. Complete the other required or optional fields, as needed.
6. Select **Execute Report**.
7. Click **Save Report**.

Workspace admins also have the option to add the **Workspace AQ Insights Earnings** metric under the **Earnings** category to a report, if desired.

Refer to [Generate, manage, or send a report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343879-generate-manage-or-send-a-report) for additional support related to creating a new report in the Reports app.

## Locate additional AQ Insights report resources

- [Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview)
- [Troubleshoot an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132530-troubleshoot-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report)

title: Troubleshoot an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report

blocks.text: Advertisers can create Audience Quality (AQ) Insights reports if their account and audiences meet certain eligibility criteria. They must also follow specific steps to successfully generate a report.
If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing an AQ Insights report, refer to these resources first:
[Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview)
[Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report)
Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage an AQ Insights report.

The workflow to generate an AQ Insights report ends with a **Generate** button that you’ll use to create your report. If your account’s available balance is less than the **AQ Cost**, this button will change to **Add Funds** to prompt you to add funds to your account instead.
You can also add funds from the Organization app. Refer to [Add and manage funds](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5734663-add-and-manage-funds) for step-by-step instructions.

A campaign is excluded from your report’s **Campaigns** list due to its [eligibility](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview#h_74980b9de1) or [status](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview#h_f52e8b13c3).
Follow these steps to troubleshoot why a given campaign is missing from the list:

Refer to [Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview) to confirm that the campaign meets all eligibility criteria.

Check the campaign’s current status and duration. You can generate AQ Insights reports for eligible campaigns that feature a **Pending**, **Running**, or **Expired** status; and have a duration of 14 or more days.

# Troubleshoot an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report

## AQ Insights report troubleshooting overview

Advertisers can create Audience Quality (AQ) Insights reports if their account and audiences meet certain eligibility criteria. They must also follow specific steps to successfully generate a report.

If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing an AQ Insights report, refer to these resources first:

- [Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview)
- [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report)

Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage an AQ Insights report.

## AQ Insights report creation troubleshooting

### Insufficient funds

The workflow to generate an AQ Insights report ends with a **Generate** button that you’ll use to create your report. If your account’s available balance is less than the **AQ Cost**, this button will change to **Add Funds** to prompt you to add funds to your account instead.

You can also add funds from the Organization app. Refer to [Add and manage funds](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5734663-add-and-manage-funds) for step-by-step instructions.

### Campaign missing from list

A campaign is excluded from your report’s **Campaigns** list due to its [eligibility](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview#h_74980b9de1) or [status](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview#h_f52e8b13c3).

Follow these steps to troubleshoot why a given campaign is missing from the list:

1. Refer to [Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview) to confirm that the campaign meets all eligibility criteria.
2. Check the campaign’s current status and duration. You can generate AQ Insights reports for eligible campaigns that feature a **Pending**, **Running**, or **Expired** status; and have a duration of 14 or more days.
3. Make sure that your **Campaign Status** selection is correct. It narrows the items included in the **Campaigns** menu to only include the campaigns that feature the status you choose. For example, if you choose **Expired**, we’ll only list eligible campaigns with an **Expired** status in the **Campaigns** field.
4. Confirm whether another AQ Insights report is still processing for the same campaign. While you can generate insights for an unlimited number of campaigns, you can generate only one AQ Insights report at a time for each campaign.

### Cannot change date range

The AQ Insights report’s **Date Range** field will auto-populate once you select a campaign. The first date reflects the campaign’s Start Date, and the second date reflects either the campaign’s End Date or today’s date minus one day–whichever took place first. These dates are not editable.

### Select Campaign is disabled - Insights app

The campaign selector becomes disabled when none of your campaigns’ statuses match the ones you selected in the **Campaign Status** menu. Refer to the number in parentheses next to each status, which indicates how many of those campaigns are eligible for AQ Insights reporting. For example, **Running (0)** indicates that zero eligible campaigns currently feature a **Running** status.

**Expired** campaigns work slightly differently. The selected campaigns must have expired within the past two years to be eligible for AQ Insights reporting.

### Generate AQ Insights is disabled - Campaigns app, Dashboard app

There may be instances where the option to **Generate AQ Insights** is disabled in the Campaign or Dashboard apps. This occurs when the selected campaign doesn’t meet the eligibility criteria, or when you’ve selected multiple campaigns.

If the selected campaign meets all eligibility criteria but the button remains disabled, note that, while you can generate insights for an unlimited number of campaigns, you can generate only one AQ Insights report at a time for each campaign.

### Cannot generate a report - Insights app

You may encounter a warning message or another issue that blocks you from generating AQ insights for a particular campaign. We build in certain blocks to help avoid charging you for highly similar datasets more than once, or generating reports inaccurately.

These blocks typically occur for one of the following reasons:

1. You can generate one AQ Insights report at a time for each campaign. Another AQ Insights report can be generated once the in-progress report displays a **Ready** status on the **Audience Quality** page. Refer to [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report) to learn how to access this page and review report statuses.
2. You can generate only one AQ Insights report when you choose the same campaign and date range. The **Generate** option won’t be available in this circumstance since the report’s data would be identical to the initial report. Instead, you can review the AQ Insights report that you already generated for the campaign.
3. You no longer have access to AQ Insights reporting.
   There may be certain cases where you’ve previously generated AQ Insights reports, but your access is now revoked due to permission changes applied by a system administrator. You won’t be able to generate new insights, but you can continue to access reports you’ve already generated for one year after their creation date.

## AQ Insights report results troubleshooting

### Cannot delete a report

We limit the ability to delete AQ Insights reports to help avoid accidental deletions of paid insights.

The **Audience Quality** page of the Insights app displays each of your AQ Insights and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can delete any **Failed** AQ Insights reports either individually or in bulk.

### Cannot email a report

The email feature may be disabled for one of the following reasons:

1. The report’s status is **Processing** or **Failed**. You can email any **Ready** AQ Insights reports.
2. The **Send Email** button is disabled. If you can access the **Email Audience Quality** pop-up window, but the **Send Email** button is disabled, note that you must enter valid email aliases to send the report to the recipients you specified. If you completed the field but the button is still disabled, you likely only added one email alias. You’ll need to click anywhere within the **Email Audience Quality** window, and outside of the **Email ID** field, for it to register. This will enable the **Send Email** button automatically.

### Cannot download a report

The **Audience Quality** page of the Insights app displays each of your AQ Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can download any **Ready** reports by following the steps outlined in [Download an AQ Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report#h_8051e9e5c1).

### Cannot edit or duplicate a report

Editing and duplication are not currently supported for AQ Insights reports.

### AQ Insights report generation failed

You encountered a technical error during report generation. Try again in a few minutes.

Note that, if an AQ Insights report features a **Failed** status, no **AQ Cost** will be deducted from the advertiser’s account balance until it successfully generates.

## Locate additional AQ Insights report resources

- [Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132023-audience-quality-aq-insights-report-overview)
- [Generate or manage an Audience Quality (AQ) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13132289-generate-or-manage-an-audience-quality-aq-insights-report)

sections.heading: Early voter and absentee ballot (AB-EV) segments
heading_path: Early voter and absentee ballot (AB-EV) segments

blocks.text: Early voter and absentee ballot (AB-EV) segments separate voters who’ve already cast a ballot, either by voting early or by returning an absentee ballot, from those who haven’t. This data comes from L2, and it’s available for states that publicly release individual-level early voting and absentee ballot records.

Combine AB-EV segments with your audience’s location, partisan lean, and demographic segments to build ballot-chasing audiences. For example, target likely supporters in a district, and exclude voters who’ve already voted early or returned an absentee ballot, so your campaign focuses on the voters who still need to act. The audience’s **Potential Reach** reflects any AB-EV segments you exclude.

To locate AB-EV segments, expand the desired state when you add segments, then open its **Early Voters/Absentee Ballot** subsection. Refer to [Create with voter segments](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13336749-create-or-manage-a-custom-voter-audience#h_7f8710f69d) for step-by-step instructions.
