# Campaign templates frequently asked questions (FAQ)

## Campaign templates overview

The Campaign Templates feature streamlines your campaign-creation operations by templatizing the [campaign targeting settings](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497708-campaign-targeting-guide) that you plan to reuse in future campaigns. Refer to [Campaigns overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497668-campaigns-overview) for more details.

## Campaign template creation FAQ

**Q: Why should I use a campaign template?**

**A:** Campaign templates offer an operational benefit to your campaign-launch process. We recommend starting new campaigns from one of your existing templates to reduce errors and move faster.

Whether starting from scratch or from a saved template, you always have the flexibility to apply changes prior to running the campaign.

**Q: What campaign types are supported?**

**A:** You can create campaign templates for both [Advanced and PG](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497668-campaigns-overview#h_97e6822e53) campaigns.

**Q: Which sections of a campaign can I save to a template?**

**A:** With the exception of the **Campaign Info** section, all of a campaign’s settings can be saved as a template. You’ll have the option to choose which to include and exclude before you finish saving the template.

**Q: Which sections of a campaign are excluded from templates?**

**A:** The **Campaign Info** section is excluded from all campaigns. You can choose additional campaign settings to include and exclude before you finish saving the template.

**Q: Can I create a campaign without a template?**

**A:** Yes, you can create a campaign without a template by selecting the “**From Scratch**” option during the creation workflow.

**Q: If I create a campaign “From Scratch”, can I still create a template?**

**A:** Yes, all new and existing campaigns include the **Save As Template** option.

**Q: If I create a campaign “From Template”, can I still change the campaign’s targeting settings?**

**A:** Yes, all of the campaign’s fields remain editable. You can treat a template as a starting point, then add or remove additional campaign settings.

**Q: If I create a campaign “From Template” and select “Save As Template”, will any changes apply to the existing template or a new one?**

**A:** Selecting **Save As Template** will create a new template each time.

**Q: How can I create a new template?**

**A:** Create a new template from any new or existing campaign by following the steps outlined in [Create or manage a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651476-create-or-manage-a-campaign).

**Q: Can I open a template in an existing campaign?**

**A:** No, applying previously templated campaign details is supported only for new campaigns. You can, however, save a template from both new and existing campaigns.

## Campaign template management FAQ

**Q: Where can I review an existing template?**

**A:** The option to view all templates is forthcoming. In the meantime, you can review a template by following the workflow to [Create a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651476-create-or-manage-a-campaign) and selecting the “**From Template”** option. Review the preloaded campaign details from the template you clicked, then cancel campaign creation without saving your changes.

**Q: How can I edit an existing template?**

**A:** The option to edit an existing template is forthcoming. In the meantime, you can create a new template from any new or existing campaign by following the steps outlined in [Create or manage a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651476-create-or-manage-a-campaign).

**Q: How can I delete an existing template?**

**A:** The option to delete an existing template is forthcoming.

## Locate additional campaign template resources

- [Campaigns overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497668-campaigns-overview)
- [Create or manage a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651476-create-or-manage-a-campaign)

# Product release notes

## Q4 2026 product release notes

### Early voter and absentee ballot (AB-EV) segments for Custom Voter audiences

##### October 20, 2026

| **Vertical** | Political |
| --- | --- |
| **Change summary** | Build ballot-chasing audiences in one place by combining early voter and absentee ballot (AB-EV) segments with a Custom Voter audience’s location, partisan lean, and demographic segments. AB-EV segments separate voters who’ve already voted early or returned an absentee ballot from those who haven’t, so your campaigns can focus on the voters who still need to act. |
| **Action required** | No action is required. |
| **Resources** | Review [Custom Voter audience overview - Early voter and absentee ballot (AB-EV) segments](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13336712-custom-voter-audience-overview#h_51bae67c51) for more information. |

##### October 15, 2026

| **Vertical** | Healthcare |
| --- | --- |
| **Change summary** | Reach healthcare professionals and patients faster with ready-to-use PurpleLab OTS segments in Segmented audiences, instead of building healthcare professional (HCP) and Patient (direct-to-consumer [DTC]) audiences from scratch. Find them under **IQM Healthcare** › **PurpleLab** › **HCP** › **OTS** and **IQM Healthcare** › **PurpleLab** › **Patient** › **OTS** when you add segments. |
| **Action required** | No action is required. |
| **Resources** | Review [Segmented audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview) for more information. |

### StatSocial political audience segments

##### October 14, 2026

| **Vertical** | Political |
| --- | --- |
| **Change summary** | Reach voters based on the news outlets, political accounts, and voices they follow and engage with on social media, using StatSocial’s political audience segments in Segmented audiences. Find them under **IQM Political** › **StatSocial** when you add segments, and combine them with geography, your voter files, or Power Segments. |
| **Action required** | No action is required. |
| **Resources** | Review [Segmented audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview) for more information. |

title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience overview

blocks.text: Integrated Care Team (ICT) audiences are a type of [Matched audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview) intended for healthcare-audience expansion. They offer healthcare advertisers a seamless way to reach broader, contextually relevant groups based on their NPI lists.

You’ll expand your selected audience sub-type (HCP, Nurse) to include other relevant care-team cohorts to avoid missing messaging opportunities, and without the need to manually create individual, supporting audiences. While the audience is generating, it recognizes consumers across channels and devices through IQM’s privacy-compliant [Identity Graph](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8615247-iqm-identity-graph), which unifies offline and online identifiers to a single profile. Targeting this segment allows you to reach these offline users through digital channels.

ICT audiences rely on the same proprietary matching technology used in [Matched audiences](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview). Data privacy measures are also applied to provide a secure and compliant audience-matching solution that not only benefits our customers but also respects the privacy rights of individuals.
If you’re a healthcare advertiser, you may be eligible to create an ICT audience.

blocks.text: When an ICT audience reaches a **Ready** status, it includes three metrics: **Records**, **Match Rate**, and **Reach**.
**Records** are the total number of line items—individual IDs or addresses, for example—included in the source file that you uploaded when you created the ICT audience.

The audience’s **Match Rate** represents the percentage of users whose digital identities we were able to correlate to the identifiers that you included in your source file. The average match rate on the IQM platform is 80%.

In campaign reporting, **Reach** represents the number of unique individuals who were exposed to your ad. In ICT audiences, however, this metric represents the total targetable audience (unique users) that you can potentially reach by targeting that particular audience. Note that the actual addressable audience will become smaller as you apply additional targeting rules and other settings to your campaign.

When you multiply the ICT audience’s total number of **Records** by its **Match Rate**, you’re left with the audience’s **Reach**. For example, if your audience achieves a 99.7% **Match Rate** and includes 1,000 **Records**, then the audience’s **Reach** is 997.
You’re more likely to achieve optimal Match Rates for an audience when you:

Include as much accurate data as possible in the file you upload when you [Create an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience).
Ensure the file’s data is accurate and properly formatted. Start by downloading the **Sample File** to check whether your file is formatted correctly as only correctly formatted rows can match.

**Re-Match notice:** Only a parent ICT audience (not an extended HCP, Nurse, or Non-NPI Nurse audience) can be Re-Matched. After a Re-Match is complete, the ICT audience’s Reach may increase, decrease, or remain the same. Note that–if the Re-Matched audience is the only mapped audience and its Reach is lower than the original ICT audience’s reach–the campaign may stop delivering.
No campaign disruption will occur during Re-Match processing; any associated campaigns will continue to target the existing ICT audience until the process is complete.

blocks.text: Certain ICT audiences support the “Re-Match” feature. Re-Matching will retrigger the audience-matching process, which fetches the most recent and relevant match data and updates the audience’s Reach and Match Rate details.

Note that Re-Matching is not an automated process. You can manually Re-Match an eligible audience by following the steps outlined in [Re-Match an ICT audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience#h_6ccab1cb99).

blocks.text: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a 10-digit numeric identifier. It’s a component of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) that serves as a unique identification number for covered healthcare providers.

When you create an ICT audience from an NPI list, you correlate these providers with their respective digital identities while upholding stringent data privacy regulations. This process enables you to effectively deliver healthcare-related ads that reach the appropriate medical professionals.

Advertisers who’d like to leverage NPI lists for audience matching should follow the steps outlined in [Create or an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience).

heading_path: Data privacy measures for ICT audiences

blocks.text: IQM’s identity graph is fully privacy compliant. IQM doesn’t track any device or cookie with “Do not track” settings enabled, and follows all CCPA and GDPR guidelines. When you create audiences with first-party data, or enable other audience-targeting features, you also agree to comply with applicable data laws and regulations including but not limited to GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.
IQM takes the following measures to provide a secure and compliant audience-matching solution that not only benefits our customers but also respects the privacy rights of individuals:

**HIPAA compliance:** Healthcare advertisers can create ICT audiences from NPI lists. Our foremost priority is aligning with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). This legislation mandates safeguarding individuals' healthcare information, a responsibility we discharge meticulously in our NPI matching process.

**Robust data encryption:** When NPI or other first-party data files include personally identifiable information (PII) such as first name, last name, and address, IQM anonymizes the data during the audience-matching process. Files are stored behind a firewall and encrypted in the case of a data breach. The rigorous data encryption measures that we have implemented are intended to preserve the confidentiality and integrity of data. These techniques also ensure data remains shielded during transit and while at rest, mitigating the risk of unauthorized access.

**Secure data storage:** All data processed within IQM undergoes secure storage, complemented by stringent access controls and comprehensive audit trails. This not only bolsters data security but also establishes traceability, an essential facet for demonstrating compliance.

**Routine compliance audits:** IQM conducts ongoing compliance audits to ascertain the continued alignment of our NPI, Voter, and other sensitive-data matching processes with the latest data privacy regulations. This unwavering commitment to compliance provides our customers with confidence, knowing they can utilize our platform without encountering legal concerns.

| **Ready (Re-Matching)** | The audience is currently undergoing the Re-Match process. Associated campaigns will continue to target the existing audience until the Re-Matching process is complete. |
| **Processing** | We’re working on generating your audience. Depending on the audience’s size, this process may take up to 48 hours. |
| **Pending** | Your audience is pending for approval. |
| **Failed** | You encountered a technical error during audience creation. We’ll attempt to regenerate it for you in a few minutes. |
| **Deleted** | Deleted audiences are automatically removed from the Audiences app as soon as you complete this action. For this reason, none of your ICT audiences will feature a **Deleted** status at any time. |

## Key terms and concepts

### Records, Match Rate, and Reach

When an ICT audience reaches a **Ready** status, it includes three metrics: **Records**, **Match Rate**, and **Reach**.

**Records** are the total number of line items—individual IDs or addresses, for example—included in the source file that you uploaded when you created the ICT audience.

The audience’s **Match Rate** represents the percentage of users whose digital identities we were able to correlate to the identifiers that you included in your source file. The average match rate on the IQM platform is 80%.

In campaign reporting, **Reach** represents the number of unique individuals who were exposed to your ad. In ICT audiences, however, this metric represents the total targetable audience (unique users) that you can potentially reach by targeting that particular audience. Note that the actual addressable audience will become smaller as you apply additional targeting rules and other settings to your campaign.

When you multiply the ICT audience’s total number of **Records** by its **Match Rate**, you’re left with the audience’s **Reach**. For example, if your audience achieves a 99.7% **Match Rate** and includes 1,000 **Records**, then the audience’s **Reach** is 997.

#### Achieving optimal Match Rates

You’re more likely to achieve optimal Match Rates for an audience when you:

- Include as much accurate data as possible in the file you upload when you [Create an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience).
- Ensure the file’s data is accurate and properly formatted. Start by downloading the **Sample File** to check whether your file is formatted correctly as only correctly formatted rows can match.

### Re-Match

> **Re-Match notice:** Only a parent ICT audience (not an extended HCP, Nurse, or Non-NPI Nurse audience) can be Re-Matched. After a Re-Match is complete, the ICT audience’s Reach may increase, decrease, or remain the same. Note that–if the Re-Matched audience is the only mapped audience and its Reach is lower than the original ICT audience’s reach–the campaign may stop delivering. No campaign disruption will occur during Re-Match processing; any associated campaigns will continue to target the existing ICT audience until the process is complete.

Certain ICT audiences support the “Re-Match” feature. Re-Matching will retrigger the audience-matching process, which fetches the most recent and relevant match data and updates the audience’s Reach and Match Rate details.

Note that Re-Matching is not an automated process. You can manually Re-Match an eligible audience by following the steps outlined in [Re-Match an ICT audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience#h_6ccab1cb99).

### Re-Match eligibility

Refer to the table below for more details on the factors that impact an ICT audience’s Re-Match eligibility.

| **Audience sub-type** | **Re-Match eligibility criteria** |
| --- | --- |
| Input audience: HCP | Every 90 days for audiences with a **Ready** status |
| Input audience: Nurse | Every 90 days for audiences with a **Ready** status |
| Extension audience: HCP, Nurse, or Non-NPI Nurse | Not eligible at any time |

### National Provider Identifier (NPI)

#### NPI numbers

A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a 10-digit numeric identifier. It’s a component of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) that serves as a unique identification number for covered healthcare providers.

#### NPI matching

When you create an ICT audience from an NPI list, you correlate these providers with their respective digital identities while upholding stringent data privacy regulations. This process enables you to effectively deliver healthcare-related ads that reach the appropriate medical professionals.

Advertisers who’d like to leverage NPI lists for audience matching should follow the steps outlined in [Create or an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience).

### Data privacy measures for ICT audiences

IQM’s identity graph is fully privacy compliant. IQM doesn’t track any device or cookie with “Do not track” settings enabled, and follows all CCPA and GDPR guidelines. When you create audiences with first-party data, or enable other audience-targeting features, you also agree to comply with applicable data laws and regulations including but not limited to GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.

IQM takes the following measures to provide a secure and compliant audience-matching solution that not only benefits our customers but also respects the privacy rights of individuals:

- **HIPAA compliance:** Healthcare advertisers can create ICT audiences from NPI lists. Our foremost priority is aligning with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). This legislation mandates safeguarding individuals' healthcare information, a responsibility we discharge meticulously in our NPI matching process.
- **Robust data encryption:** When NPI or other first-party data files include personally identifiable information (PII) such as first name, last name, and address, IQM anonymizes the data during the audience-matching process. Files are stored behind a firewall and encrypted in the case of a data breach. The rigorous data encryption measures that we have implemented are intended to preserve the confidentiality and integrity of data. These techniques also ensure data remains shielded during transit and while at rest, mitigating the risk of unauthorized access.
- **Secure data storage:** All data processed within IQM undergoes secure storage, complemented by stringent access controls and comprehensive audit trails. This not only bolsters data security but also establishes traceability, an essential facet for demonstrating compliance.
- **Routine compliance audits:** IQM conducts ongoing compliance audits to ascertain the continued alignment of our NPI, Voter, and other sensitive-data matching processes with the latest data privacy regulations. This unwavering commitment to compliance provides our customers with confidence, knowing they can utilize our platform without encountering legal concerns.

## Locate additional ICT resources

- [Create or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience)
- [Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943848-troubleshoot-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience)

cleaned_markdown:
# Create or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience

## ICT audience overview

Integrated Care Team (ICT) audiences are an expansion of[Matched audiences](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview) designed for Healthcare advertisers. They broaden reach beyond your NPI lists to include relevant care-team cohorts that share similar characteristics, and without requiring manual creation for those individual audiences.

Using IQM’s privacy-compliant[Identity Graph](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8615247-iqm-identity-graph), ICT audiences unify offline and online identifiers to target these users digitally. They rely on proprietary matching technology and apply [data privacy measures](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_4a6651496d) for a secure, compliant solution.

Refer to [Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview) for more information and eligibility requirements, or continue reading to create and manage an ICT audience.

## Create an ICT audience

Follow these steps to create an ICT audience for Healthcare campaigns:

1. Open the Audiences app.
2. Select **ICT Audience**.
3. Click **+ Create New.** This will open the **Create ICT Audience** pop-up window.
4. Enter a name for the audience.
5. Choose whether your NPI file contains **HCP** or **Nurse** identifiers.
6. Select at least one **Extension Audience**.
   1. A separate audience will be created for the parent ICT audience and each selected **Extension Audience**.
7. Select the **Data Partner** of your choice.
8. Add an XLSX or CSV file containing the list of NPIs.
   1. Download the **Sample** file to ensure your file is formatted correctly.
   2. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to upload it, click **Upload File** and select it.
   3. If the desired file is stored in your device’s local files and you’d like to drag and drop it, select the desired file and drag it into any area of the dashed rectangle.
   4. If the desired file is stored in an external account such as Google Drive or Dropbox, select the corresponding company’s icon.
      1. A pop-up window will open and prompt you to log in, accept any applicable privacy settings, and select the desired file from the online drive.
9. Open the **Primary Matching Criteria** menu and select the system field(s) contained in your file that will be used for audience matching.
10. Complete the required **System Fields** and **Uploaded File Columns** in the table.
    1. Click **+ Add Field** to add additional fields to the table.
    2. Only one row is required; however, completing more will help increase the chances of a [high Match Rate](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_ba9254eb18).
11. Select Create.

Your ICT audience and extension audience(s) will immediately begin processing. You can monitor their current status by following the steps outlined in Review an ICT audience.

## Manage an ICT audience

Use the **ICT Audience** page of the Audiences app to review, search, sort, or filter your existing ICT audiences and extension audience(s). You can also use this page to change their name or delete them, and assign them to campaigns.

### Review an ICT audience

Follow these steps to review an existing ICT audience:

1. Locate the audience you’d like to review.
   1. Search by **ID**, **Parent ID**, or **Audience Name**.
   2. Filter by **Status**, **Data Partner**, and/or **Type** (HCP, Nurse, Non-NPI Nurse).
   3. Open the column selector to add or remove a table column.
2. Select the desired audience’s ID in the **ID** column. This will open that audience in a pop-up window, where you can review its details.
3. Review the audience details.
   1. In the summary panel, review the audience’s Created On date, Type, Partner, and Status. Once the audience features a **Ready** status, you can also review additional data and insights such as Reach, Match Rate, and CPM Cost.
   2. Download and review the file you uploaded when you created the audience.
   3. Review the names and IDs of the Extension Audience(s) created from the uploaded audience.
4. Select **Done** to close the pop-up window and return to the ICT Audience page.

### Re-Match an ICT audience

> **Re-Match notice:** After a Re-Match is complete, the ICT audience’s Reach may increase, decrease, or remain the same. Note that–if the Re-Matched audience is the only mapped audience and its Reach is lower than the original audience’s Reach–the campaign may stop delivering. No campaign disruption will occur during Re-Match processing; any associated campaigns will continue to target the existing ICT audience until the process is complete. Refer to [Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience overview - Re-Match](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_f49e6e0909) for more details on audience Re-Matching and eligibility criteria.

Follow these steps to retrigger the audience-matching process, which fetches the most recent and relevant match data and updates the ICT audience’s Reach and Match Rate details:

1. Select the refresh icon next to an eligible audience. This will open the **Confirm Audience Re-Match** pop-up window.
2. Review the disclaimer and any associated campaigns.
3. Select **Re-Match** to confirm your selection.

### Edit an ICT audience

> **More on editing ICT audiences:** Only an existing ICT audience’s name can be edited. If you’d like to apply changes to the audience’s other settings—such as its source file or type—consider creating a new one instead.

Follow these steps to edit an existing ICT audience’s name:

1. Select the existing name from the table’s **Audience Name column**, and type the new audience name directly in the cell.
2. Click the checkmark icon to confirm your selection.

### Duplicate an ICT audience

Duplication isn’t supported for ICT audiences.

Follow the steps outlined in Create an ICT audience to create a new audience instead.

### Delete an ICT audience

> **Audience deletion notice:** Note that deleted audiences are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent.

You can delete ICT audiences individually or in bulk. They must feature a **Ready**, **Processing**, or **Failed** status; and their **Allowlist/Blocklist** count must be **0**.

Follow these steps to delete an ICT audience:

1. To delete audiences individually, use the **Actions** column to select the trash can icon next to the individual audience that you’d like to delete
2. To delete audiences in bulk:
   1. Select the checkboxes next to the desired audiences.
   2. Click **Delete**.

The deleted audience(s) will no longer appear in the Audiences app.

## Assign an ICT audience to a campaign

> **Notice on existing campaigns:** You can assign an ICT audience to existing campaigns that are already targeting another ICT audience or aren’t targeting any audiences. Refer to [ICT audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_c2daebcd8d) for more details.

ICT audiences can be assigned to new or existing campaigns from the Audiences app or Campaigns app. A signal campaign can target up to 20 audiences.

Refer to [Assign an audience to a campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497815-assign-an-audience-to-a-campaign) for step-by-step instructions.

## Review data costs

The **Data Cost** metric represents a campaign’s total spend or targeting and/or blocking data segments. This includes the total amount spent on audience targeting.

You can review a campaigns’ data costs in the following ways:

- From the Dashboard app
- From the Campaigns app
- From the Reports app

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Dashboard app

Follow the steps outlined in [Customize a dashboard table - Add or remove a column](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10471726-create-or-manage-a-dashboard#h_35346e0a69) to choose which metrics are displayed on your dashboard. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it.

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Campaigns app

In the Campaigns app, open the column selector to choose which metrics are displayed in the table. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it.

### Review a campaign’s data costs from the Reports app

Follow the steps outlined in [Generate a report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343879-generate-manage-or-send-a-report#h_6d07656e4b) to create a custom report. Select the **Data Cost** metric from the **Spending** category to add it to the report.

## Locate additional ICT audience resources

- [Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview)
- [Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943848-troubleshoot-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience)

# Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience

## ICT audience troubleshooting overview

Healthcare advertisers create and target Integrated Care Team (ICT) audiences if their account and campaign meet certain eligibility criteria.

If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating, managing, or targeting an ICT audience, refer to these resources first:

- [Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience)

Return to this article to address and resolve other issues that you may encounter related to ICT audiences.

## Troubleshoot ICT audience creation or management issues

### Unable to duplicate an audience

Duplication isn't supported for ICT audiences.

Follow the steps outlined in [Create or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience) to create a new audience instead.

### Unable to edit an audience

Only an existing ICT audience’s name can be edited. You can rename an audience directly from the **ICT Audience** table by selecting the cell containing the existing name.

### Unable to change an audience’s name

You can change an existing audience’s name by selecting it in the table’s **Audience Name** column.

Type the new audience name directly in the cell, and confirm your selection by clicking the checkmark icon.

### Unable to delete an audience

You can delete audiences individually or in bulk. Every selected audience must be unassigned from all campaigns before you can delete them.

You can easily reference whether an audience is assigned to any campaigns in the **Allowlist/Blocklist** column. Audiences with an **Allowlist/Blocklist** value of **0** can be deleted.

### Unable to locate a deleted audience

Deleted audiences are automatically removed from the Audiences app as soon as you complete this action. For this reason, none of the ICT audiences listed in the Audiences app will feature a **Deleted** status.

### Unable to review audience reach

Audience reach details generate automatically once the audience progresses from a **Processing** status to a **Ready** status. Refer to [ICT audience statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_42234a9f4d) and [Key terms and concepts - Records, Match Rate, and Reach](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_ba9254eb18) for more information.

### Audience is in Processing status

Depending on the size of the ICT audience, it may take 24 to 48 hours for us to complete the audience-matching process. Once completed, the audience’s status will change from **Processing** to **Ready**. If something goes wrong during audience creation, then it’ll feature a **Failed** status instead.

### Unable to upload additional source files

Each ICT audience can include one source file containing your NPI list. The parent audience and any extended audiences (HCP, Nurse, and/or Non-NPI Nurse) are all generated from the same file.

Repeat the processes outlined in [Create or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience) to upload another source file.

### Unable to Re-Match an audience

An audience’s Re-Match eligibility is determined by the audience sub-type and the number of days that have passed since the audience was last created or Re-Matched.

Refer to [Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience overview - Re-Match](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_f49e6e0909) for more details.

### Audience Re-Match failed

An audience undergoing the Re-Match process may fail for any of the following reasons:

- A system error or technical error occurred during processing.
- The parent audience failed to generate, so no extended audiences (HCP, Nurse, and/or Non-NPI Nurse) could be generated.
- The newly Re-Matched audience’s Reach would have equaled less than 10 users.

Follow the steps outlined in [Re-Match an ICT audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience#h_6ccab1cb99) to try again.

## Troubleshoot ICT audience targeting issues

### New campaign - Unable to select a PG campaign type

PG campaigns aren’t eligible for ICT audience targeting. When you create a new campaign that will target the ICT audience, the **Advanced** option is selected by default, and the **PG** option is disabled.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to a PG campaign

Only **Advanced** campaigns are eligible for targeting ICT audiences. For this reason, the **Audiences** section is intentionally excluded from **PG** campaigns.

### Existing campaign - Unable to add to an Advanced campaign

Campaigns typically support targeting multiple audience types. A campaign targeting an ICT audience, however, must only include one or more ICT audiences.

If the campaign isn’t targeting any other audience types, confirm how many audiences it’s targeting instead. One campaign can target up to 20 audiences.

### Existing campaign - Campaign is missing from list

If you’re attempting to add the ICT audience to an existing campaign, and that campaign isn’t available in the **Campaigns** list, the campaign isn’t eligible for ICT audience targeting. Refer to [ICT audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_c2daebcd8d) for more details.

### Add To Campaign button is disabled

The **Add To Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting and/or none of your campaigns are currently eligible.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [ICT audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_c2daebcd8d) for more details.

### Create Campaign button is disabled

The **Create Campaign** button becomes disabled when the audience(s) you selected aren’t currently eligible for targeting.

Confirm that each audience you selected features a **Ready** or **Processing** status, and refer to [ICT audience eligibility requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview#h_c2daebcd8d) for more details.

## Locate additional ICT audience resources

- [Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview)
- [Create or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943755-create-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-audience)

# Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview

## NLD Insights report overview

Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights reports offer deeper visibility into how nurses engage with your campaigns. They uncover ad-exposure, engagement, demographic, and physician-specialty data to reveal reach and impact.

By covering Non-NPI nurses, NLD Insights reports paint a more comprehensive picture of the care team and help you validate whether your campaigns are connecting with the right healthcare professionals across channels.

## NLD Insights report eligibility requirements

Certain healthcare advertisers are eligible to generate NLD Insights reports. The following conditions must also be met prior to NLD Insights report generation.

| **Requirement** | **Requirement details** |
| --- | --- |
| **Campaign vertical*** | Healthcare |
| **Campaign type** | Advanced |
| **Campaign status** | Running Expired (within the past 2 years) Paused |
| **Campaign duration** | At least 7 days through yesterday’s date |
| **Campaign limit** | Up to 50 eligible campaigns from the same insertion order (IO) per report |
| **Audience type** | Campaign must target at least one Non-NPI Nurse ([Matched](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview), [Geofarmed](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6871135-geofarmed-audience-overview), [Contextual](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6972375-contextual-audience-overview)) audience |

***Healthcare:** Any campaign created under a healthcare advertiser account is a “Healthcare” campaign.

## NLD Insights report pricing

There is a cost associated with generating an NLD Insights report. You can reference its price after you enter key details–like the source campaigns and their date ranges–and before you generate the report. We calculate the report’s chargeable impressions on a CPM basis.

Refer to [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report) for more information on where to reference the report-price preview.

### Price deduction - Sufficient funds

The **NLD Insights Cost** is deducted from your account’s available balance when a one-time report successfully generates, and each time a scheduled report successfully generates.

Refer to [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report) for step-by-step instructions on creating a new report and setting up or managing a delivery schedule.

### Price deduction - Insufficient funds

> **Funds notice:** Organization administrators can add funds to an account. Contact yours to complete this process.

The **NLD Insights Cost** is deducted from your account’s available balance when a one-time report successfully generates, and each time a scheduled report successfully generates. However, there may be instances when your account’s available funds are too low to cover the report’s NLD Insights Cost.

When you create a new report, you can click **Add Funds** directly from the report creation workflow to select a payment method and enter the desired amount you’d like to add.

When you schedule a recurring report and there are insufficient funds, the report’s generation will automatically fail. Specific users will be notified of the generation failure via email, and you’ll have an opportunity to add funds from your report template and regenerate the report.

Refer to [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report#h_51edc0bbff) for step-by-step instructions on managing failed reports and adding funds.

### Pricing for NLD Insights reports with overlapping datasets

There may be instances when you generate multiple NLD Insights reports with partially overlapping date ranges for the same campaign. You may also choose to aggregate data for recurring scheduled reports. This means that the insight data also overlaps. You’ll pay only once for NLD Insights—you won’t be charged again for the same combination of impressions and dates.

**Example:** You generate two reports for the same campaign—one with a date range of August 1st-10th, and another with a date range of August 5th-20th. Since you already paid for the insights from August 1st-10th, we’ll only change you for a portion of the second report: the new data generated for the August 11th-20th date range. We’ll still aggregate data from the full August 5th-20th date range in the second report.

## NLD Insights report metrics

NLD Insights reports return ad exposure and demographic metrics at the user level.

| **Metric title** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **Impressions** | The number of times the user viewed your ad. |
| **Clicks** | The number of times the user clicked on your ad. |
| **Conversions** | The number of a user’s conversions that can be attributed to your ad. |
| **Completes** | The number of times that the video creative played for its entire duration. |
| **State License ID** | The unique, government-issued identifier verifying that a professional is licensed to practice healthcare in a specific state. |
| **First Name** | The user’s legal first name. |
| **Last Name** | The user’s legal last name. |
| **Specialty** | The branch of patients, diseases, or skills that the user evaluates, diagnoses, or manages at medical practice. |
| **ZIP** | The user’s permanent residence location details (ZIP Code). |
| **Geo Lat** | The latitudinal coordinates of the device that the ad was served on. |
| **Geo Lon** | The longitudinal coordinates of the device that the ad was served on. |
| **IP Address** | The IP address that the device was connected to when the ad was served. |
| **DMA** | The Designated Market Area (DMA) that the campaign targeted, which is a region of the United States that Nielsen defined to measure local television viewership. |
| **Exchange** | The tech platform that made the buying and selling of ad inventory across ad networks possible. |
| **Advertiser** | The advertiser account that created the campaign. |
| **Browser** | The web browser that the ad was served on. |
| **Campaign ID** | The campaign’s unique identifier. |
| **Campaign** | The campaign’s name. |
| **State** | The state where the user’s device was located when the ad was served. |
| **Creative ID** | The served creative’s unique identifier. |
| **Creative Size** | The dimensions of the ad. |
| **Creative Name** | The served creative’s name. |
| **Creative Type** | The format of the ad creative (image, HTML, video, audio, or native). |
| **IAB Category** | The IAB Tech Lab page-content category that the campaign targeted. |
| **Device Type** | The category of device (TV, tablet, desktop, or mobile) that the ad was served on. |
| **Device Manufacturer** | The company that created the device that the ad was served on. |
| **Device OS** | The Operating System (OS) that the user was connected to when they were served the ad. |
| **Carrier Name** | The company that provided the cellular data necessary for the ad to serve over SMS, phone calls, or internet access. |

## NLD Insights report statuses

You can review a NLD Insights report’s current status on the **Nurse Level Data** page.

| **Status** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **Ready** | Your insights are generated. You can view, download, or email the NLD Insights report. |
| **Processing** | We’re working on generating your insights. Check back in about 15 minutes. |
| **Failed* - with an “X” icon** | You either encountered a technical error during report generation, or the campaign you selected is no longer eligible for NLD Insights reporting. Try again in a few minutes to rule out a technical error. |
| **Failed* - with a “$” icon** | You scheduled a report, but it couldn’t be generated because your account had insufficient funds. Refer to Price deduction - Insufficient funds for more information. |

* If an NLD Insights report features a **Failed** status, no **NLD Insights Cost** will be deducted from the advertiser’s balance.

## NLD Insights report scheduling

Schedule reports to take full control of NLD Insights reporting with minimal effort. Define a list of email aliases that should receive the insights, and choose how often to generate and share the reports with those users.

### Delivery frequency

You’ll define a delivery frequency when you create a scheduled report. You can edit or stop the delivery schedule at any time. Refer to [Send an NLD Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report#h_b8d0783d73) for instructions on how to schedule one-time or recurring email delivery.

| **Delivery frequency category** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **One time** | Generate and send the report only once. If you plan to schedule recurring email delivery, consider first selecting **One time** to send it immediately, then proceed with defining a recurring frequency. |
| **Daily** | Generate and send the report every day up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Weekly** | Generate and send the report every week, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Monthly** | Generate and send the report every month, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Custom** | Generate and send the report at a repeating daily, weekly, or monthly cadence of your choice. For example, set up a custom frequency of every two weeks. |
| **Template status - Active** | Allow the report’s delivery frequency settings to be executed until the **End Date (optional)** you specify is reached, or until you change the template’s status to **Inactive**. |
| **Template status - Inactive** | Stop the report’s delivery frequency settings from being executed until you change the template’s status back to **Active**. |

## Key terms and concepts

### Data aggregation

When you set up recurring delivery for an NLD Insights report, you’ll have the option to enable **Data Aggregations**.

When enabled, the report is generated from the report’s start date to the last day, week, or month–depending on the delivery schedule–prior to the report’s delivery date. In other words, the data is aggregated over a rolling time frame.

When disabled, the report is generated for the period of time between the last generated report and the most recent scheduled day, week, or month–depending on the delivery schedule. For example, a weekly report with **Data Aggregations** disabled will include data from only the past week.

# Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report

## NLD Insights report overview

Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights reports offer deeper visibility into how nurses engage with your campaigns. They uncover ad-exposure, engagement, demographic, and physician-specialty data to reveal reach and impact.

By covering Non-NPI nurses, NLD Insights reports paint a more comprehensive picture of the care team and help you validate whether your campaigns are connecting with the right healthcare professionals across channels.

You can generate an NLD Insights report if your campaigns and account meet certain criteria. Refer to [Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview) for more information.

## Generate a one-time or recurring NLD Insights report

You can generate an NLD Insights report in the following ways:

- From the Insights app
- From the Campaigns app
- From the Dashboard app

### Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app

Follow these steps to generate an NLD Insights report and choose a one-time or recurring delivery schedule:

1. Open the Insights app.
2. Select **Nurse Level Data**.
3. Click **+ Create New**. This will open the **Generate and Schedule NLD** pop-up window.
4. Enter a name for this NLD template.
   1. All recurring reports will be nested under this template’s name.
5. Choose whether the campaigns are **Running**, **Paused**, or **Expired** from the **Campaign Status** menu.
6. Search and select the campaign(s) for which you want to generate insights.
7. To schedule a one-time report delivery:
   1. Choose a **One-Time** delivery frequency.
   2. Select a time frame from the **Date Range** field.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
8. To schedule a daily report delivery:
   1. Choose a **Daily** delivery frequency.
   2. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
9. To schedule a weekly report delivery:
   1. Choose a **Weekly** delivery frequency.
   2. Choose on which day of the week the weekly report should be delivered (e.g., on Mondays).
   3. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
10. To schedule a monthly report delivery:
    1. Choose a **Monthly** delivery frequency.
    2. Choose on which day of the month the monthly report should be delivered (e.g., on the **First Day of Month** or on the 15th day of the month).
    3. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
       1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
11. To schedule report delivery for a custom time frame:
    1. Choose a **Custom** delivery frequency.
    2. Choose how often the report should be delivered. The following values are supported:
       1. Day(s): 1-365
       2. Week(s): 1-52
       3. Month(s): 1-12
    3. Choose on which day the custom report should be delivered (e.g., on Mondays).
    4. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
       1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
12. Enter an email alias for each report recipient, separated by commas.
13. If desired, select the **Data Aggregations** toggle to enable aggregation.
    1. The option to aggregate data is available for NLD reports with a **Daily**, **Weekly**, **Monthly**, or **Custom** delivery frequency.
    2. Refer to [Key terms and concepts: Data aggregation](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview#h_d9aef0f29d) for more details.
14. Click **Next**.
15. Review a summary of your report selections and scheduling settings.
16. Select **Generate** (one-time delivery frequency) or **Schedule** (recurring delivery frequency)
    1. The **NLD Insights Cost** will be deducted from your account’s available balance as soon as the report generates.

Once generated, you can find the NLD Insights report on the Insights app’s **Nurse Level Data** page. Review Manage an NLD Insights report for details on how to review, download, send, or delete a report.

### Generate an NLD Insights report from the Campaigns app

Follow these steps to take a shortcut to NLD Insights report generation from the Campaigns app:

1. Open the Campaigns app.
2. Choose an insertion order (IO) to arrive at the **Insertion Order Info** page.
3. Select the checkbox(es) next to the campaign(s) for which you want to generate insights.
4. Click **Generate NLD Insights** from the **More** menu. This will redirect you to the **Generate and Schedule NLD** page of the Insights app, and auto-populate the campaign(s)’ or IO’s name and date range.
   1. You can only select **Generate NLD Insights** if all selected campaigns are eligible for NLD Insights reporting.
5. Follow steps 7 through 16 of the Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app workflow to generate and/or schedule the report.

### Generate an NLD Insights report from the Dashboard app

Follow these steps to take a shortcut to NLD Insights report creation from the Dashboard app:

1. Open the Dashboard app.
2. Filter or search the dashboard to locate the desired IO or campaign(s).
3. Click the checkbox(es) next to the IO or campaign(s).
4. Select **Generate NLD Insights** from the **More** menu. This will redirect you to the **Generate and Schedule NLD** page of the Insights app, and auto-populate the campaign(s)’ or IO’s name and date range.
   1. You can only select **Generate NLD Insights** if all selected campaigns are eligible for NLD Insights reporting.
5. Follow steps 7 through 16 of the Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app workflow to generate and/or schedule the report.

## Manage an NLD Insights report

> **NLD Insights report availability notice:** You can access generated NLD Insights reports up to one year after their creation date.

The **Nurse Level Data** page displays each of your NLD Insights report templates and their statuses. You can use the **Actions** column to manage your existing NLD Insights report templates and their delivery schedules; or the **Reports** column to review, download, and send generated reports.

- Download
- Email
- Delete

### Download an NLD Insights report

Follow these steps to download a generated NLD Insights report:

1. Select the number of generated reports in the **Reports** column. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template.
2. Click **Download** from the desired generated report’s **Actions** column.
3. Choose whether you’d like to download the report as a CSV or XLSX file.
4. Select **Done** to close the **Reports** pop-up window and return to the **Nurse Level Data** page.

You’ll receive your insights as a single CSV or XLSX file if the spreadsheet contains 100K or less rows. Otherwise, you’ll receive them as a ZIP file containing multiple files. For example, if the report contains a total of 150K rows and you choose to download the insights as an XLSX file, then your download will include one ZIP file containing two XLSX files: one with 100K rows and one with 50K rows.

### Email a generated NLD Insights report

Follow these steps to email a generated NLD Insights report to yourself and other recipients:

1. Select the number of generated reports in the **Reports** column. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template.
2. Click the envelope icon from the desired generated report’s **Actions** column.
3. Choose whether you’d like to send the report as a CSV or XLSX file. This will open the **Email Nurse Level Data** pop-up window.
4. Add up to 15 email aliases to the **Email ID** field, separated by commas.
5. Select **Send Email**.
6. Click **Done** to close the **Reports** pop-up window and return to the **Nurse Level Data** page.

### Delete an NLD Insights report

> **More on report deletion:** We limit the ability to delete most NLD Insights reports to help avoid accidental deletions of paid insights. You can, however, delete **Failed** NLD Insights reports.

Follow these steps to delete a **Failed** NLD Insights report:

1. Select the number of generated reports in the **Reports** column. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template.
2. Select the checkbox(es) next to the **Failed** report(s) you want to delete.
3. Click **Delete**.
4. Confirm your selection.
5. Click **Done** to close the **Reports** pop-up window and return to the **Nurse Level Data** page.

## Send an NLD Insights report

> **Email notice:** The email includes a link to the report rather than a file attachment when the report’s file size is greater than 25 MB. This limitation is to comply with the file-size restrictions of most email inboxes.

You’ll set up a report’s generation and delivery schedule when you first create it. You can manage these settings at any time by following the steps outlined below.

### Schedule email delivery for an existing report template

Follow these steps to schedule one-time or recurring email delivery for an existing report template:

1. Select the pencil icon in the **Actions** column of the desired report template.
2. Follow steps 5 through 16 of the Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app workflow.

### Edit a report delivery schedule

Follow these steps to change an existing one-time or recurring report delivery schedule:

1. Select the pencil icon in the **Actions** column of the desired report template.
2. Follow steps 5 through 16 of the Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app workflow to choose the report’s new delivery schedule and apply your changes.

### Stop a recurring report delivery schedule

Follow these steps to pause a scheduled report:

1. Select the pencil icon in the **Actions** column of the desired report template. This will open the **Generate and Schedule NLD** pop-up window for the existing report template.
2. In the **Delivery Details** section, select the **Template status** toggle switch to change the status from **Active** to **Inactive**.
3. Click **Next**.
4. Review a summary and apply your changes.

The template’s status will remain inactive until you resume the report delivery schedule.

### Resume a paused report delivery schedule

Follow these steps to resume delivery for a report template that you previously paused:

1. Select the pencil icon in the **Actions** column of the desired report template. This will open the **Generate and Schedule NLD** pop-up window for the existing report template.
2. In the **Delivery Details** section, select the **Template status** toggle switch to change the status from **Inactive** to **Active**.
3. Click **Next**.
4. Review a summary and apply your changes.

The template’s status will remain active until you pause the report delivery schedule.

### Generate again

> **Failed report cost notice:** If an NLD Insights report features a **Failed** status, no NLD Insights Cost will be deducted from your balance until the report successfully generates. Refer to [Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview) for more information.

Follow these steps to re-attempt report generation for an NLD Insights report featuring a **Failed** status:

1. Select the number of generated reports in the **Reports** column. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template.
2. To re-attempt report generation for individual **Failed** reports, select **Generate Again** from a report’s **Actions** column.
3. To re-attempt report generation in bulk:
   1. Select the checkbox(es) next to the **Failed** report(s).
   2. Click **Generate Again**.

## Review past NLD Insights report spend

You can review past NLD Insights report spend in the following ways:

- From the Dashboard app
- From the Reports app

### Review past NLD Insights report spend from the Dashboard app

Follow these steps to review the total amount spent on NLD Insights report generation from the Dashboard app:

1. Open the Dashboard app.
2. Open the **View By** menu and click **Campaigns**, **Insertion Orders**, or **Advertiser**, depending on your preference.
   1. Workspace admins also have the option to select **Workspace**.
3. Select **NLD Insights Cost** from the **Columns** menu.
   1. The **NLD Insights Cost** column will populate in the table.
   2. Workspace admins also have the option to select **Workspace NLD Insights Earnings**.
4. Adjust the dashboard’s **Time Zone** and **Date Range** details to view the amount spent on NLD report generation within a specific time frame, if desired.

### Review past NLD Insights report spend from the Reports app

Follow these steps to review the total amount spent on NLD Insights report generation from the Reports app:

1. Open the Reports app.
2. Click **+ Create Report**. This will open the **Create New Report** page.
3. Locate and expand the **Spending** category.
4. Drag the **NLD Insights Cost** metric into the **Columns** field.
5. Complete any other required or optional fields, as needed.
6. Select **Execute Report**.
7. Click **Save Report**.

Workspace admins also have the option to add the **Workspace NLD Insights Earnings** metric under the **Earnings** category to a report.

Refer to [Generate, manage, or send a report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343879-generate-manage-or-send-a-report) for additional support related to creating a new report.

title: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report

blocks.text: Advertisers can create Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights reports if their account and campaigns meet certain eligibility criteria. They must also follow specific steps to successfully generate a report.
If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing an NLD Insights report, refer to these resources first:
[Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview)
[Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report)
Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage NLD Insights reports.
Your IQM homepage includes all apps that your Workspace administrator has enabled you to access. Contact yours to request the appropriate permissions to access the Insights app, if applicable.

The workflow to generate an NLD Insights report ends with a **Generate** button. If your account’s available balance is less than the price of the NLD Insights report, this button will prompt you to add funds to the account instead.

# Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report

## NLD Insights report troubleshooting overview

Advertisers can create Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights reports if their account and campaigns meet certain eligibility criteria. They must also follow specific steps to successfully generate a report.

If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing an NLD Insights report, refer to these resources first:

- [Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview)
- [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report)

Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage NLD Insights reports.

## NLD Insights report creation troubleshooting

### Cannot locate Insights app

Your IQM homepage includes all apps that your Workspace administrator has enabled you to access. Contact yours to request the appropriate permissions to access the Insights app, if applicable.

### Insufficient funds

The workflow to generate an NLD Insights report ends with a **Generate** button. If your account’s available balance is less than the price of the NLD Insights report, this button will prompt you to add funds to the account instead.

For scheduled reports, the report will fail to generate if the account has insufficient funds during the report-generation attempt.

Refer to the steps outlined in [Add and manage funds](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5734663-add-and-manage-funds) to add funds from the Organization app, or contact your organization administrator to complete this process.

### Campaign is missing from list

A campaign is typically excluded from the **Campaign** list due to its [eligibility](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview#h_16b5936a23) or [status](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview#h_8ddc40d0bf), or the total number of selected campaigns.

- **Eligibility:** In the Insights app, the **Campaign** list only includes campaigns that are eligible for NLD report creation. Likewise, in the Campaigns and Dashboard apps, the option to generate an NLD report is only available for eligible campaigns. Refer to [Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview) for more information on the factors that make your account and campaign eligible for NLD Insights report generation.
- **Status:** You can generate NLD Insights reports for eligible campaigns featuring a **Pending**, **Running**, or **Expired** status. When you generate a report from the Insights app, you’ll select the campaign’s current status before opening the **Campaign** list. This selection narrows the available campaign options. For example, when **Expired** is selected, the **Campaign** list will only include eligible campaigns featuring an **Expired** status.
- **Total number of selected campaigns:** Up to 50 campaigns can be selected per NLD Insights report.

To help reduce errors next time, consider generating an NLD Insights report from the Campaigns or Dashboards apps. Unlike in the Insights app, these two workflows will pre-populate the **Campaign Status**, **Campaign**, and Date Range fields during setup.

Refer to [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report) for more information on how to generate an NLD Insights report from the Campaigns or Dashboard apps.

### Cannot generate a report

You may encounter a warning message or another issue that blocks you from generating NLD Insights data from a particular campaign and across a particular date range. We build in certain blocks to help avoid charging you for highly similar datasets more than once, or generating reports inaccurately.

These blocks typically occur for one of the following reasons:

- **You can generate one NLD Insights report at a time for each campaign**. You can generate another NLD Insights report once your in-progress report displays a **Ready** status on the **Nurse Level Data** page. Refer to [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report) to learn how to access this page.
- **You can’t generate an identical NLD Insights report.** If you attempt to report on the same campaign(s) and dates of an existing report, the **Generate** option won’t be available in the **Generate Nurse Level Data** widget. Instead, you can review the NLD Insights report that you already generated for this campaign and the selected date range.

There may be certain cases where you’ve previously generated NLD Insights reports, but your access is now revoked. For example, your signed MSA for NLD Insights reporting may have expired. You won’t be able to generate new insights, but you can continue to access reports you’ve already generated for up to one year after their creation date.

### Date Range field is disabled

The **Date Range** field automatically becomes enabled after one or more campaigns is selected from the **Campaign** list.

### Cannot select my preferred date range

An NLD Insights report’s dates must meet these criteria:

- You can select date ranges of up to 365 days.
- The dates you select must have taken place during the campaign’s date range, and it must have served impressions on each of those dates.

Consider generating multiple NLD Insights reports for the same campaign if its duration exceeds 365 days.

### Cannot select my preferred delivery schedule

You can choose to generate the NLD Insights report one time, daily, weekly, or monthly.

If you’d prefer to enter a custom delivery frequency, select **Custom** from the **Delivery Frequency** menu, and enter how often the report should be delivered. The following values are supported:

- Day(s): 1-365
- Week(s): 1-52
- Month(s): 1-12

### Template Status toggle switch is disabled

You can manage an NLD Insights report template’s delivery schedule status (**Active**, **Inactive**) when the selected **Delivery Frequency** is Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Custom.

Since reports with a One Time frequency are only generated once, the option to make it **Active** or **Inactive** isn’t available. Update the report template’s **Delivery Frequency** to enable the toggle switch.

## NLD Insights report results troubleshooting

### Cannot delete a report

We limit the ability to delete NLD Insights reports to help avoid accidental deletions of paid insights.

The **Nurse Level Data** page of the Insights app displays each of your NLD Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can delete any **Failed** reports either individually or in bulk.

### Cannot email a report

The email feature is disabled when the report’s status is **Processing** or **Failed**.

The **Nurse Level Data** page of the Insights app displays each of your NLD Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can email any **Ready** reports.

### Email includes a link rather than the report file

The email includes a link to the report rather than a file attachment when the report’s file size is greater than 25 MB. This limitation is to comply with the file-size restrictions of most email inboxes.

### Cannot locate a generated report

One-time and recurring generated reports are nested within the NLD report template that you created.

To review a generated report, select the number in the **Reports** column for the desired report template. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template, where you can review, download, and email each of your generated reports.

Refer to [Manage an NLD Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report#h_0ba87a582a) for step-by-step instructions.
